examples.chinese: 听到他失业的消息后，我立刻打电话去安慰他。

examples.chinese: 我们在河岸边散步，享受着傍晚的凉风。

examples.chinese: 游客们从船上跳下来，一上岸上就急忙寻找旅馆。

examples.chinese: 工作了一整天，我的肩膀很酸痛，晚上去按摩店按摩了一个小时，感觉舒服多了。

examples.chinese: 我计划下个月拜访我在北京的朋友，一起去故宫旅游。

examples.chinese: 看到火灾的时候，我立即报警，消防队很快就赶到了。

examples.chinese: 他总是抱怨工作太累，但从来不想改变现状。

examples.chinese: 我这辈子最后悔的事就是没有好好学习。

examples.chinese: 他感冒了，鼻子堵得很厉害，整天都在擤鼻子。

examples.chinese: 比方说,如果你想学好中文,就需要每天练习。

examples.english: For example, if you want to learn Chinese well, you need to practice every day.

examples.english: Among the company's total costs, the proportion of employee salaries is the largest.

examples.chinese: 科学家们在北极发现了许多新的物种，这对气候变化的研究很重要。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zài běijí fāxiànle xǔduō xīn de wùzhǒng, zhè duì qìhòu biànhuà de yánjiū hěn zhòngyào.

examples.chinese: 这篇文章需要编辑修改一下，才能发表。

examples.chinese: 如果你想成功，必须付出更多的努力。

examples.chinese: 这部电影不止一次获得国际大奖，深受观众喜爱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng búzhǐ yī cì huòdé guójì dàjiǎng, shēnshòu guānzhòng xǐhuài.
examples.english: This movie has won international awards more than once and is deeply loved by audiences.

examples.chinese: 根据这些线索，我猜测他可能去了北京出差。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhèxiē xiànsuǒ, wǒ cāicè tā kěnéng qùle běijīng chūchāi.
examples.english: Based on these clues, I guess he probably went to Beijing on a business trip.

examples.chinese: 我们的预算不足，无法完成这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de yùsuàn bùzú, wúfǎ wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: Our budget is not enough to complete this project.

examples.chinese: 公司需要采购新的办公设备，所以派我去市场调查一下价格。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào cǎigòu xīn de bàngōng shèbèi, suǒyǐ pài wǒ qù shìchǎng tiáochá yīxià jiàgé.
examples.english: The company needs to purchase new office equipment, so they sent me to the market to check the prices.

examples.chinese: 那位裁判的判罚引起了观众的强烈不满。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi cáipàn de pànfá yǐnqǐ le guānzhòng de qiángliè búmǎn.
examples.english: The referee's decision provoked strong dissatisfaction from the audience.

examples.chinese: 我猜你肯定又忘记了我们的约定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cāi nǐ kěndìng yòu wàngjì le wǒmen de yuēdìng.
examples.english: I guess you've definitely forgotten our agreement again.

examples.chinese: 这家餐馆的菜很地道，每天都有很多客人来吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānguǎn de cài hěn dìdào, měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō kèrén lái chīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are very authentic, and there are many customers eating here every day.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜做得很地道，每天都有很多顾客来吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài zuò de hěn dìdào, měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō gùkè lái chīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are very authentic, and it has many customers coming to eat every day.

examples.chinese: 他每周都买彩票，希望有一天能中大奖。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu dōu mǎi cǎipiào, xīwàng yǒu yī tiān néng zhòng dà jiǎng.
examples.english: He buys lottery tickets every week, hoping to win the jackpot one day.

examples.chinese: 夏天的时候，我们一家人去内蒙古的草原上骑马，那是我最美好的回忆。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, wǒmen yī jiārén qù Nèi Měnggǔ de cǎoyuán shang qímǎ, nà shì wǒ zuì měihǎo de huíyì.
examples.english: In the summer, my family went horseback riding on the grasslands of Inner Mongolia, which is my most beautiful memory.

examples.chinese: 这个公司的管理层次太多了，导致工作效率很低。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de guǎnlǐ céngcì tài duō le, dǎozhì gōngzuò xiàolǜ hěn dī.
examples.english: This company has too many administrative levels, which results in low work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 这套教材一共有十册，我已经读完了前五册。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào jiàocái yīgòng yǒu shí cè, wǒ yǐjīng dúwán le qián wǔ cè.
examples.english: This set of textbooks has ten volumes in total, and I have already finished reading the first five volumes.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的餐饮服务获得了很多顾客的好评。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de cānyǐn fúwù huòdéle hěnduō gùkè de hǎopíng.
examples.english: This company's catering service has received a lot of positive reviews from customers.

examples.chinese: 我用叉子吃了一口牛排，觉得味道不错。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng chāzi chīle yī kǒu niúpái, juéde wèidào búcuò.
examples.english: I took a bite of steak with a fork and thought it tasted pretty good.

examples.chinese: 城市和乡村的生活方式有很大的差别。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì hé xiāngcūn de shēnghuó fāngshì yǒu hěn dà de chābié.
examples.english: There is a significant disparity between the lifestyles in cities and rural areas.

examples.chinese: 这两个学生的成绩差距很大，一个考了90分，另一个只考了60分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge xuésheng de chéngjì chājù hěn dà, yī ge kǎole 90 fēn, lìng yī ge zhǐ kǎole 60 fēn.
examples.english: The gap between these two students' grades is very large; one scored 90 points while the other only scored 60 points.

examples.chinese: 我需要查询一下我的账户余额。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào cháxún yīxià wǒ de zhànghù yúé.
examples.english: I need to inquire about my account balance.

examples.chinese: 他把钥匙插进门锁里，然后转动了一下。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yàoshi chā進mén suǒ lǐ, ránhòu zhuǎndòng le yīxià.
examples.english: He inserted the key into the door lock and then turned it.

examples.chinese: 我用叉子叉了一块牛排放进嘴里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng chāzi chāle yī kuài niúpái fàngjìn zuǐlǐ.
examples.english: I forked a piece of steak and put it in my mouth.

examples.chinese: 我差点儿忘了今天要开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎnr wàngle jīntiān yào kāihuì.
examples.english: I almost forgot that there's a meeting today.

examples.chinese: 政府决定拆除这些老旧的建筑，为城市发展腾出空间。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juéduìng chāichú zhèxiē lǎojiù de jiànzhù, wèi chéngshì fāzhǎn ténɡchū kōngjiān.
examples.english: The government decided to demolish these old buildings to make space for urban development.

examples.chinese: 他们决定把这栋老房子拆成几个部分来改造。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng bǎ zhè dòng lǎo fángzi chāi chéng jǐ ge bùfen lái gǎizào.
examples.english: They decided to divide this old building into several sections to renovate.

examples.chinese: 这条河的长度超过了一千公里，是我们国家最重要的水系。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de chángdù chāoguòle yī qiān gōnglǐ, shì wǒmen guójiā zuì zhòngyào de shuǐxì.
examples.english: The length of this river exceeds one thousand kilometers, making it the most important water system in our country.

english: Changshou suburban district of Chongqing municipality

examples.chinese: 我们计划下个月去长寿旅游，听说那里的风景很美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà xiàge yuè qù Chángshòu lǚyóu, tīng shuō nàlǐ de fēngjǐng hěn měi.
examples.english: We're planning to travel to Changshou next month. I heard the scenery there is very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，我们国家的新能源产业增长得很快。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, wǒmen guójiā de xīn néngliàng chǎnyè zēngzhǎng de hěn kuài.
examples.english: As technology develops, our country's new energy industry is growing very quickly.

examples.chinese: 医生检查了他的肠道，发现有轻微的炎症。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiǎnchájile tāde chángdào, fāxiàn yǒu qīngwēi de yánzhèng.
examples.english: The doctor examined his intestines and found mild inflammation.

examples.chinese: 我尝过这家餐厅的新菜，味道真的很不错。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángguo zhè jiā cāntīng de xīn cài, wèidào zhēnde hěn búcuò.
examples.english: I've tasted the new dishes at this restaurant, and they really taste quite good.

examples.chinese: 我决定尝试一种新的学习方法，看看效果是否会更好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juédìng chángshì yī zhǒng xīn de xuéxí fāngfǎ, kànkan xiàoguǒ shìfǒu huì gèng hǎo.
examples.english: I decided to attempt a new study method to see if the results would be better.

examples.chinese: 新来的厂长决定改革生产流程，这让许多员工感到担心。
examples.pinyin: Xīn lái de chǎngzhǎng juédìng gǎigé shēngchǎn liúchéng, zhè ràng xǔduō yuángōng gǎndào dānxīn.
examples.english: The newly arrived factory director decided to reform the production process, which made many employees feel worried.

examples.chinese: 昨天的婚礼现场真是壮观，那场面我这辈子都忘不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de hunyǐ xiànchǎng zhēnshi zhuànguān, nà chǎngmiàn wǒ zhèi bèizi dōu wàng bu liǎo.
examples.english: Yesterday's wedding venue was truly spectacular; I will never forget that scene for the rest of my life.

examples.chinese: 这位运动员的成绩超越了上一届的记录。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yùndòngyuán de chéngjì chāoyuè le shàng yī jiè de jìlù.
examples.english: This athlete's performance surpassed the record from the previous competition.

examples.chinese: 政府倡导人们保护环境，减少使用塑料袋。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chàngdǎo rénmen bǎohù huánjìng, jiǎnshǎo shǐyòng sùliào dài.
examples.english: The government advocates for people to protect the environment and reduce the use of plastic bags.

examples.chinese: 人们都称他为这个行业的专家。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen dōu chēng tā wéi zhège hángyè de zhuānjiā.
examples.english: People all call him an expert in this industry.

examples.chinese: 那位车主因为停车位的问题和邻居发生了争执。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi chēzhǔ yīnwèi tíngchēwèi de wèntí hé línjū fāshēngle zhēngzhí.
examples.english: That vehicle owner had a dispute with his neighbor over a parking space issue.

examples.chinese: 这笔房产交易经过三个月的谈判终于成交了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ fángchǎn jiāoyì jīngguò sān ge yuè de tánpàn zh终于 chéngjiāo le.
examples.english: After three months of negotiation, this real estate transaction finally concluded.

examples.chinese: 经过三个月的努力，我们的减肥计划终于显示出了成效。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò sān ge yuè de nǔlì, wǒmen de jiǎnféi jìhuà zh终于 xiǎnshì chūle le chéngxiào.
examples.english: After three months of effort, our weight loss plan finally showed results.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成本比我们预期的要高得多。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chéngběn bǐ wǒmen yùqī de yào gāo de duō.
examples.english: The cost of this project is much higher than we expected.

examples.chinese: 这次国际会议由我们公司承办，需要做很多准备工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì huìyì yóu wǒmen gōngsī chéngbàn, xūyào zuò hěnduō zhǔnbèi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Our company is undertaking this international conference, and we need to do a lot of preparatory work.

examples.chinese: 城里的房价太高了，很多年轻人都搬到郊区去了。
examples.pinyin: Chénglǐ de fángjià tài gāo le, hěnduō niánqīngrén dōu bāndào jiāoqū qù le.
examples.english: The housing prices in the city are too high, so many young people have moved to the suburbs.

examples.chinese: 我们乘坐高铁去北京只需要五个小时。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chéngzuò gāotiě qù Běijīng zhǐ xūyào wǔ ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: It only takes us five hours to get to Beijing by taking the high-speed train.

english: to ride (in a car or carriage)

examples.chinese: 我们明天早上乘车去机场，需要提前两小时出发。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang chéngchē qù jīchǎng, xūyào tíqián liǎng xiǎoshí chūfā.
examples.english: We will ride in a car to the airport tomorrow morning and need to leave two hours early.

examples.chinese: 我们明天乘坐飞机去北京出差。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān chéngzuò fēijī qù Běijīng chūchāi.
examples.english: We will take a plane to Beijing for a business trip tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的时间表很紧张，对我们的团队来说有点吃力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de shíjiānbiǎo hěn jǐnzhāng, duì wǒmen de tuánduì lái shuō yǒudiǎn chīlì.
examples.english: The timeline for this project is tight, which is a bit strenuous for our team.

examples.chinese: 公园里的池子里有很多锦鲤，游客们喜欢在那里喂鱼。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ de chízi lǐ yǒu hěnduō jǐnlǐ, yóukèmen xǐhuān zài nàlǐ wèi yú.
examples.english: There are many koi in the pond in the park, and visitors like to feed the fish there.

examples.chinese: 这班飞机上有很多乘客，他们都在排队登机。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān fēijī shang yǒu hěnduō chéngkè, tāmen dōu zài paiduì děngjī.
examples.english: There are many passengers on this flight, and they are all queuing to board.

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息太兴奋了，冲动地就买了一张去日本的机票。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī tài xīngfènle, chōngdòng de jiù mǎile yī zhāng qù Rìběn de jīpiào.
examples.english: When he heard the news, he got so excited that he impulsively bought a plane ticket to Japan.

examples.chinese: 如果你再迟到，老板会对你很不满意。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ zài chídào, lǎobǎn huì duì nǐ hěn búmǎnyì.
examples.english: If you're late again, your boss will be very dissatisfied with you.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的资金充足，所以团队可以专心研发新产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de zījīn chōngzú, suǒyǐ tuánduì kěyǐ zhuānxīn yánfā xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This project has ample funding, so the team can focus on developing new products.

examples.chinese: 两个部门之间的冲突已经影响到了公司的工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge bùmén zhījiān de chōngtū yǐjīng yǐngxiǎng dàole gōngsī de gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The conflict between the two departments has already affected the company's work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 他为了孩子的教育问题愁得睡不好觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile háizi de jiàoyù wèntí chóu de shuì bu hǎo jiào.
examples.english: He is so worried about his child's education that he can't sleep well.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的厨房里飘来一股臭味，我们决定换一个地方吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de chúfáng lǐ piāo lái yī gǔ chòu wèi, wǒmen juédìng huàn yī ge dìfang chīfàn.
examples.english: A bad smell drifted from the kitchen of this restaurant, so we decided to eat somewhere else.

examples.chinese: 丑先生是我们公司的新经理，他来自上海。
examples.pinyin: Chǒu xiānsheng shì wǒmen gōngsī de xīn jīnglǐ, tā láizì Shànghǎi.
examples.english: Mr. Chou is the new manager of our company, and he's from Shanghai.

english: to go on an official or business trip

examples.chinese: 我下个月要出差到上海，需要提前准备一些文件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàge yuè yào chūchāi dào Shànghǎi, xūyào tíqián zhǔnbèi yīxiē wénjiàn.
examples.english: I need to go on a business trip to Shanghai next month and need to prepare some documents in advance.

examples.chinese: 这本小说今年终于要出版了，作者花了五年时间才完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jīnnián终于 yào chūbǎn le, zuòzhě huāle wǔ nián shíjiān cái wánchéng.
examples.english: This novel is finally coming off the press this year; the author spent five years to complete it.

examples.chinese: 今天天气太热了，我在公交车上出了很多汗。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ zài gōngjiāochē shang chūle hěnduō hàn.
examples.english: It's so hot today that I perspired a lot on the bus.

examples.chinese: 这个项目在初期遇到了很多困难，但团队没有放弃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zài chūqī yùndàole hěnduō kùnnan, dàn tuánduì méiyǒu fàngqì.
examples.english: The project encountered many difficulties in its initial stage, but the team didn't give up.

examples.chinese: 他出于好意想帮助我们，但结果反而让事情变得更复杂了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūyú hǎoyì xiǎng bāngzhù wǒmen, dàn jiéguǒ f反而 ràng shìqing biàn de gèng fùzá le.
examples.english: He wanted to help us out of good intentions, but the result actually made things more complicated.

examples.chinese: 除非你有特别的原因，否则我们还是按照原计划去旅行吧。
examples.pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ yǒu tèbié de yuányīn, fǒuzé wǒmen háishi ànzhào yuán jìhuà qù lǚxíng ba.
examples.english: Unless you have a special reason, let's stick to the original plan and go on the trip.

examples.chinese: 我们公司的厨房很小，员工们经常在那里一起吃午餐。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de chúfáng hěn xiǎo, yuángōngmen jīngcháng zài nàlǐ yìqǐ chī wǔc餐。
examples.english: Our company's office kitchen is very small, and employees often eat lunch together there.

examples.chinese: 公司对迟到的员工进行了处罚，扣除了他们一天的工资。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī duì chídào de yuángōng jìnxíng le chǔfá, kòuchú le tāmen yī tiān de gōngzī.
examples.english: The company punished the employees who were late by deducting one day's salary from them.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天，全家人聚在一起吃团圆饭，庆祝新年的到来。
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān, quánjiā rén jù zài yīqǐ chī tuányuán fàn, qìngzhù xīnnián de dàolái.
examples.english: On lunar New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers together to eat reunion dinner and celebrate the arrival of the new year.

examples.chinese: 他因为迟到多次被公司给予了处分。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chídào duō cì bèi gōngsī gěiyǔle le chǔfèn.
examples.english: He received a punishment from the company because he was late multiple times.

examples.chinese: 经理要求我把这个重要的消息传达给所有的员工。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yāoqiú wǒ bǎ zhège zhòngyào de xiāoxi chuándá gěi suǒyǒu de yuángōng.
examples.english: The manager asked me to pass on this important message to all the employees.

examples.chinese: 请把这个重要的信息传递给其他团队成员。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhège zhòngyào de xìnxī chuándì gěi qítā tuánduì chéngyuán.
examples.english: Please transmit this important message to the other team members.

examples.chinese: 这幅传真画得栩栩如生，完全捕捉到了人物的神态。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú chuánzhēn huà de xǔxǔ rúshēng, wánquán bǔzhuō dàole rénwù de shéntài.
examples.english: This portraiture is so lifelike that it completely captures the person's expression and demeanor.

examples.chinese: 早上阳光太强了，我拉上了窗帘才能继续睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang yángguāng tài qiáng le, wǒ lāshàng le chuānglián cái néng jìxù shuìjiào.
examples.english: The sunlight was too strong in the morning, so I closed the curtains to continue sleeping.

examples.chinese: 我们的公司现在处在一个发展的关键时期。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de gōngsī xiànzài chǔzài yīgè fāzhǎn de guānjiàn shíqī.
examples.english: Our company is currently in a critical period of development.

examples.chinese: 他不顾家人的反对，执意闯进了娱乐圈。
examples.pinyin: Tā búgù jiārén de fǎnduì, zhíyì chuǎngjìnle yúlèhuà圈.
examples.english: He rushed into the entertainment industry despite his family's opposition.

examples.chinese: 这家公司是由几位年轻的工程师在2010年创立的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì yóu jǐ wèi niánqīng de gōngchéngshī zài 2010 nián chuànglì de.
examples.english: This company was founded by several young engineers in 2010.

examples.chinese: 我在查阅这本辞典的时候发现了很多有趣的成语用法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài cháyuè zhè běn cídiǎn de shíhou fāxiàn le hěnduō yǒuqù de chéngyǔ yòngfǎ.
