examples.chinese: 在这个快速发展的时代，我们需要跟随技术的步伐，否则就会被淘汰。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège kuàisù fāzhǎn de shídài, wǒmen xūyào gēnsuí jìshù de búfá, fǒuze jiù huì bèi táotài.
examples.english: In this rapidly developing era, we need to keep abreast with the pace of technology, otherwise we will be eliminated.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂采用了先进的工艺，生产的产品质量在行业中最好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng cǎiyòngle xiāngjìn de gōngyì, shēngchǎn de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng zài hángyè zhōng zuì hǎo.
examples.english: This factory adopted advanced technology, and the quality of its products is the best in the industry.

examples.chinese: 我们公司规定工作日不能迟到，必须准时打卡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī guīdìng gōngzuòrì búnéng chídào, bìxū zhǔnshí dǎkǎ.
examples.english: Our company has a rule that employees cannot be late on workdays and must clock in on time.

examples.chinese: 这个应用程序需要更新才能正常使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng chéngxù xūyào gēngxīn cáinéng zhèngcháng shǐyòng.
examples.english: This application needs to be updated in order to work properly.

examples.chinese: 他是我们公司公认的最好的销售员。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen gōngsī gōngrèn de zuì hǎo de xiāoshòu yuán.
examples.english: He is publicly recognized as the best salesman in our company.

examples.chinese: 这个数学公式太复杂了，我花了半小时才理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shùxué gōngshì tài fùzá le, wǒ huāle bàn xiǎoshí cái lǐjiě.
examples.english: This math formula is too complicated; it took me half an hour to understand it.

examples.chinese: 公司今天公告了新的产品发布日期。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīntiān gōnggàole xīn de chǎnpǐn fā布rì qī.
examples.english: The company announced the new product launch date today.

examples.chinese: 作为一名法官，他以公正和廉洁而闻名。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng fǎguān, tā yǐ gōngzhèng hé liánjiié ér wénmíng.
examples.english: As a judge, he is known for his impartiality and integrity.

examples.chinese: 这次出差我们访问了五个城市，共计花了两周的时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chūchāi wǒmen fǎngwènle wǔ ge chéngshì, gòngjì huāle liǎng zhōu de shíjiān.
examples.english: During this business trip, we visited five cities and spent a total of two weeks.

examples.chinese: 我们希望能够共享这个美好的时刻，一起庆祝这个重要的日子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xīwàng nénggòu gòngxiǎng zhège měihǎo de shíkè, yìqǐ qìngzhù zhège zhòngyào de rìzi.
examples.english: We hope to enjoy this beautiful moment together and celebrate this important day as one.

examples.chinese: 我们需要加强沟通，这样才能避免误会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jiāqiáng gōutōng, zhèyàng cáinéng bìmiǎn wùhuì.
examples.english: We need to strengthen our communication so that we can avoid misunderstandings.

examples.chinese: 雨后，田里的沟里积满了水。
examples.pinyin: Yǔhòu, tiánlǐ de gōu lǐ jīmǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: After the rain, the ditches in the fields were filled with water.

examples.chinese: 音乐会上，鼓手用力敲鼓，节奏感很强。
examples.pinyin: Yīnyuèhuì shang, gǔshǒu yònglì qiāo gǔ, jiézòuǔ gǎn hěn qiáng.
examples.english: At the concert, the drummer hit the drum forcefully with a strong sense of rhythm.

examples.chinese: 根据天气预报，明天估计会下雨，所以我决定不去户外运动了。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān gūjì huì xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ juéding búqù hùwài yùndòng le.
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it is estimated that it will rain tomorrow, so I decided not to do outdoor activities.

examples.chinese: 这座古老的寺庙吸引了许多游客前来参观。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de sìmiào xīyǐnle xǔduō yóukè qiánlái cānguān.
examples.english: This ancient temple attracts many tourists to visit.

examples.chinese: 当演员走上舞台时，观众们都站起来热烈地鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: Dāng yǎnyuán zǒu shàng wǔtái shí, guānzhòngmen dōu zhàn qǐlai huōliè de gǔ zhǎng.
examples.english: When the actor came onto the stage, the audience stood up and applauded enthusiastically.

examples.chinese: 老师鼓励我们在课堂上大胆提问，不要害怕犯错。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì wǒmen zài kètáng shang dàdǎn tíwèn, búyào hàipà犯cuò.
examples.english: The teacher encourages us to ask questions boldly in class and not be afraid of making mistakes.

examples.chinese: 我们公司最近聘请了一位市场顾问来帮助我们制定新的营销策略。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zuìjìn pìnqǐngle yī wèi shìchǎng gùwèn lái bāngzhù wǒmen zhìdìng xīn de yíngxiāo cèlüè.
examples.english: Our company recently hired a market counselor to help us develop a new marketing strategy.

examples.chinese: 父母对孩子的关怀是无条件的，他们总是尽力为我们创造最好的生活环境。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi de guānhuái shì wú tiáojiàn de, tāmen zǒngshì jìnlì wèi wǒmen chuàngzào zuì hǎo de shēnghuó huanjìng.
examples.english: Parents' loving care for their children is unconditional; they always try their best to create the best living environment for us.

examples.chinese: 成功的关键是要坚持不懈，不能半途而废。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng de guānjiàn shì yào jiānchí búxié, búnéng bàntú érfèi.
examples.english: The key to success is perseverance; you cannot give up halfway.

examples.chinese: 他凭借多年的训练，终于成为了这次比赛的冠军。
examples.pinyin: Tā píngjiè duō nián de xùnliàn, zh终于 chéngwéi le zhè cì bǐsài de guànjūn.
examples.english: Through many years of training, he finally became the champion of this competition.

examples.chinese: 我觉得他今天的行为很奇怪，一整天都没有说话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tā jīntiān de xíngwéi hěn guàiguài, yī zhěngtiān dōu méiyǒu shuōhuà.
examples.english: I find his behavior today very strange; he hasn't spoken all day.

examples.chinese: 能为国家服务是一件光荣的事情。
examples.pinyin: Néng wéi guójiā fúwù shì yī jiàn guāngróng de shìqing.
examples.english: It is an honorable thing to be able to serve one's country.

examples.chinese: 早上的光线透过窗户洒进房间，让整个空间看起来明亮温暖。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang de guāngxiàn tòuguò chuānghu sǎ jìn fángjiān, ràng zhěngge kōngjiān kànqǐlái míngliàng nuǎnhuо.
examples.english: The morning light filtered through the window and flooded the room, making the entire space look bright and warm.

examples.chinese: 这家公司在全国有很广的销售网络。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zài quánguó yǒu hěn guǎng de xiāoshòu wǎngluò.
examples.english: This company has a very wide sales network throughout the country.

examples.chinese: 这个新产品在市场上获得了广泛的认可和支持。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn chǎnpǐn zài shìchǎng shang huòdé le guǎngfàn de rènkě hé zhīchí.
examples.english: This new product has gained extensive recognition and support in the market.

examples.chinese: 他们发现了一个隐藏的鬼计，想要在会议上陷害竞争对手。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen fāxiànle yī ge yǐncáng de guǐjì, xiǎngyào zài huìyì shang xiànhai jìngjìng duìsh手。
examples.english: They discovered a hidden sinister plot to frame their competitor at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 公司今年规划投资一个新的项目来扩大市场。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián guīhuà tóuzī yīgè xīn de xiàngmù lái kuòdà shìchǎng.
examples.english: The company plans to invest in a new project this year to expand the market.

examples.chinese: 我在厨房的柜子里找到了一些过期的罐头。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chúfáng de guìzi lǐ zhǎodào le yīxiē guòqī de罐tou。
examples.english: I found some expired cans in the kitchen cupboard.

examples.chinese: 水已经滚了，你可以把面条放进去了。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ yǐjīng gǔn le, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ miàntiáo fàngjìnqu le.
examples.english: The water is already boiling, you can put the noodles in now.

examples.chinese: 申请这个工作需要提供你的国籍证明和身份证。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng zhège gōngzuò xūyào tígōng nǐ de guójí zhèngmíng hé shēnfènzhèng.
examples.english: To apply for this job, you need to provide proof of your nationality and ID card.

examples.chinese: 妈妈在厨房里用高压锅煮粥，香味飘满了整个房间。
examples.pinyin: Māma zài chúfang lǐ yòng gāoyālì guō zhǔ zhōu, xiāngwèi piāomǎn le zhěngge fángjiān.
examples.english: Mom is cooking porridge in a pressure cooker in the kitchen, and the aroma fills the entire room.

examples.chinese: 这项政策的目的是提高全国国民的生活水平。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de mùdì shì tígāo quánguó guómín de shēnghuó shuǐpíng.
examples.english: The purpose of this policy is to improve the living standards of citizens across the country.

examples.chinese: 他对这个项目过于乐观，没有考虑到可能出现的问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù guòyú lèguān, méiyǒu kǎolǜ dào kěnéng chūxiàn de wèntí.
examples.english: He is overly optimistic about this project and hasn't considered potential problems that might arise.

examples.chinese: 我吃了海鲜以后出现了过敏反应，全身都痒。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chīle hǎixiān yǐhòu chūxiànle guòmǐn fǎnyìng, quánshēn dōu yǎng.
examples.english: After eating seafood, I had an allergic reaction and my whole body itched.

examples.chinese: 这种污染会害死很多海洋生物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wūrǎn huì hàisǐ hěnduō hǎiyáng shēngwù.
examples.english: This kind of pollution will kill many marine organisms.

examples.chinese: 他因为过度工作而病倒了，医生建议他好好休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi guòdù gōngzuò ér bìng dào le, yīshēng jiànyì tā hǎohāo xiūxi.
examples.english: He fell ill because of overworking, and the doctor advised him to rest well.

examples.chinese: 希望你在面试中好运，相信你一定能成功。
examples.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ zài miànshì zhōng hǎoyùn, xiāngxìn nǐ yīdìng néng chénggōng.
examples.english: I hope you have good luck in the interview; I'm confident you'll definitely succeed.

examples.chinese: 学校号召所有学生参加志愿服务活动。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào hàozhào suǒyǒu xuésheng cānjiā zhìyuàn fúwù huódòng.
examples.english: The school called on all students to participate in volunteer service activities.

examples.chinese: 历史上的许多可汗都来自蒙古草原。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ shàng de xǔduō kěhàn dōu láizì Měnggu cǎoyuán.
examples.english: Many khans in history came from the Mongolian grasslands.

examples.chinese: 这两个公司决定合并，以便更好地竞争国际市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge gōngsī juédìng hébìng, yǐbiàn gèng hǎo de jìngjìng guójì shìchǎng.
examples.english: The two companies decided to merge in order to better compete in the international market.

examples.chinese: 这种塑料是用石油合成的，所以价格受油价影响很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng sùliào shì yòng shíyóu héchéng de, suǒyǐ jiàgé shòu yóujià yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
examples.english: This type of plastic is synthesized from petroleum, so its price is greatly affected by oil prices.

examples.chinese: 公司食堂今天没有开门，我只好买了一个盒饭在办公室吃。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī shítáng jīntiān méiyǒu kāimén, wǒ zhǐhǎo mǎile yī ge héfàn zài bàngōngshì chī.
examples.english: The company cafeteria didn't open today, so I had no choice but to buy a meal in a box to eat in the office.

examples.chinese: 我买了一盒巧克力送给妈妈作为生日礼物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yī hé qiǎokèlì sòng gěi māma zuòwéi shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: I bought a box of chocolates to give to my mom as a birthday gift.

examples.chinese: 我买了几张贺卡，想在生日派对上送给朋友们。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng hèkǎ, xiǎng zài shēngrì pàiduì shang sòng gěi péngyoumen.
examples.english: I bought several greeting cards that I want to give to my friends at the birthday party.

examples.chinese: 我很恨自己当初没有好好学习，现在找工作特别困难。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hèn zìjǐ dāngchū méiyǒu hǎohāo xuéxí, xiànzài zhǎo gōngzuò tèbié kùnnan.
examples.english: I deeply regret not studying hard back then, and now it's especially difficult to find a job.

examples.chinese: 我在办公室的抽屉里放了一个盒子，里面装着重要的文件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài bàngōngshì de chōutì lǐ fàngle yīgè hézi, lǐmiàn zhuāngzhe zhònyào de wénjiàn.
examples.english: I put a box in the drawer of my office that contains important documents.

examples.chinese: 我很后悔没有好好珍惜那段时光，现在想起来都觉得可惜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hòuhuǐ méiyǒu hǎohāo zhēnxī nà duàn shíguāng, xiànzài xiǎng qǐlái dōu juéde kěxī.
examples.english: I really regret not cherishing that period of time well, and now when I think back on it, I feel sorry.

examples.chinese: 北京的胡同儿里有很多老字号餐馆，每天都吸引了许多游客来品尝传统美食。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng de hútonɡr lǐ yǒu hěnduō lǎozìhào cāntīnɡ, měitiān dōu xīyǐnle hěnduō yóukè lái pǐncháng chuántǒnɡ měishí.
examples.english: The alleys in Beijing have many old-established restaurants that attract many tourists every day to taste traditional food.

examples.chinese: 他几天没有刮胡子，看起来显得很邋遢。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐ tiān méiyǒu guā húzi, kàn qǐlai xiǎnde hěn lāta.
examples.english: He hasn't shaved in several days and looks quite unkempt.

examples.chinese: 动物园里的那只猴子很聪明，它能学会做各种技巧。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de nàzhī húozi hěn聪明，tā néng xuéhuì zuòhuà gèzhǒng jìqiǎo.
examples.english: The monkey in the zoo is very intelligent and can learn to do various tricks.

examples.chinese: 随着全球化的发展，越来越多的人开始学习华语。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiúhuà de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ xuéxí huáyǔ.
examples.english: With the development of globalization, more and more people are beginning to learn Chinese language.

examples.chinese: 这只老虎在动物园里很受游客欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī lǎohǔ zài dòngwùyuán lǐ hěn shòu yóukè huānyíng.
examples.english: This tiger is very popular with visitors at the zoo.

examples.chinese: 下雨天的地板很滑，走路要小心。
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ tiān de dìbǎn hěn huá, zǒulù yào xiǎoxin.
examples.english: The floor is very slippery on rainy days, so you need to be careful when walking.

examples.chinese: 博物馆里展出了一些恐龙化石，吸引了很多游客。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ zhǎnchūle yīxiē kǒnglóng huàshí, xīyǐnle hěnduō yóukè.
examples.english: The museum displayed some dinosaur fossils, which attracted many visitors.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的画面非常震撼，让我看得目不转睛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de huàmiàn fēicháng zhènhàn, ràng wǒ kàn de mù bù zhuǎnjing.
examples.english: The visuals/frames of this movie are very stunning, making me watch without blinking.

examples.chinese: 这个项目需要划分成几个阶段来完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào huàfēn chéng jǐ ge jiēduàn lái wánchéng.
examples.english: This project needs to be divided into several stages to complete.

examples.chinese: 这个项目最重要的环节是质量检测，我们不能出任何错误。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zuì zhòngyào de huánjié shì zhìliàng jiǎncè, wǒmen búnéng chū rènhé cuòwù.
examples.english: The most important segment of this project is quality inspection, and we cannot make any mistakes.

examples.chinese: 他慌忙地收拾行李，生怕赶不上飞机。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāngmáng de shōushí xíngli, shēngpà gǎnbushàng fēijī.
examples.english: He packed his luggage in a great rush, afraid that he would miss the flight.

examples.chinese: 听到这个坏消息，她一下子慌了，不知道该怎么办。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège huài xiāoxi, tā yīxiàzi huāngle, búzhīdào gāi zěnyàm bàn.
examples.english: Upon hearing this bad news, she panicked all of a sudden and didn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 他对未来的态度很灰色，总是看不到希望。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wèilái de tàidù hěn huīsè, zǒngshì kànbujiàn xīwàng.
examples.english: His attitude toward the future is quite pessimistic; he can never see any hope.

examples.chinese: 他多年来一直帮助我，我想找个机会好好回报他的恩情。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái yīzhí bāngzhù wǒ, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo ge jīhuì hǎohāo huíbào tā de ēnqíng.
examples.english: He has been helping me for many years, and I want to find an opportunity to repay his kindness properly.

examples.chinese: 在年底的时候，我们需要回顾一下这一年的工作成果。
examples.pinyin: Zài niándǐ de shíhou, wǒmen xūyào huígù yīxià zhè yī nián de gōngzuò chénɡguǒ.
examples.english: At the end of the year, we need to look back on this year's work achievements.

examples.chinese: 这家公司专门回收旧手机，然后提取里面的贵金属。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhuānmén huíshōu jiù shǒujī, ránhòu tíqǔ lǐmiàn de guìjīnshǔ.
examples.english: This company specializes in recycling old phones and then extracting the precious metals inside.

examples.chinese: 他一直在回避这个敏感的话题，不想引起不必要的麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí zài huíbì zhège mǐngǎn de huàtí, búxiǎng yǐnqǐ búbìyào de máfan.
examples.english: He has been avoiding this sensitive topic because he doesn't want to cause unnecessary trouble.

examples.chinese: 他在街上走着，听到朋友叫他，立刻回头看了一眼。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jiēshang zǒuzhe, tīngdào péngyou jiào tā, lìkè huítóu kànle yīyǎn.
examples.english: He was walking down the street when he heard his friend calling him, and immediately turned his head to take a look.

examples.chinese: 经过两周的休息，他的身体逐渐恢复了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng zhōu de xiūxi, tā de shēntǐ zhújiàn huīfù le.
examples.english: After two weeks of rest, his body gradually recovered.

examples.chinese: 我收到了你的信，会尽快回信的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudàole nǐ de xìn, huì jìnkuài huíxìn de.
examples.english: I received your letter and will reply as soon as possible.

examples.chinese: 我需要尽快汇款到国外账户，因为明天就是截止日期了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào jǐnkuài huìkuǎn dào guówaì zhànghù, yīnwèi míngtiān jiùshì截止 rìqī le.
examples.english: I need to remit money to my overseas account as soon as possible because tomorrow is the deadline.

examples.chinese: 这个年轻的团队充满了活力，他们的创意想法给公司带来了很大的变化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège niánqīng de tuánduì chōngmǎnle huólì, tāmen de chuàngyì xiǎngfǎ gěi gōngsī dàiláile hěn dà de biànhuà.
examples.english: This young team is full of vitality, and their creative ideas have brought great changes to the company.

examples.chinese: 两国领导人昨天进行了一次重要的会谈，讨论了贸易合作的问题。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó lǐngdǎo rén zuótiān jìnxíng le yī cì zhòngyào de huìtán, tǎolùn le màoyì hézuò de wèntí.
examples.english: The leaders of the two countries had an important talk yesterday and discussed issues regarding trade cooperation.

examples.chinese: 这个小女孩很活泼，每天都在院子里跑来跑去，让整个家庭充满了欢声笑语。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo nǚhái hěn huópo, měi tiān dōu zài yuànzi lǐ pǎolái pǎoqu, ràng zhěngge jiātǐng chōngmǎn le huānshēng xiàoyǔ.
examples.english: This little girl is very lively; she runs around in the yard every day, filling the whole family with laughter and joyful voices.

examples.chinese: 每当我看到老照片，就会回忆起童年在乡村度过的快乐时光。
examples.pinyin: Měi dāng wǒ kàndào lǎo zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíyì qǐ tóngniánzài xiāngcūn dùguò de kuàilè shíguāng.
examples.english: Whenever I look at old photos, I recall the happy times I spent in the countryside during my childhood.

examples.chinese: 他找不到火柴，所以没有办法点燃蜡烛。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎo bu dào huǒchái, suǒyǐ méiyǒu bànfǎ diǎnrán làzhú.
examples.english: He couldn't find any matches, so he had no way to light the candles.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的火腿三明治很有名，每天都有很多客人来买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de huǒtuǐ sānmíngzhì hěn yǒumíng, měi tiān dōu yǒu hěnduō kèrén lái mǎi.
examples.english: This restaurant's ham sandwich is quite famous, and many customers come to buy it every day.

examples.chinese: 你可以选择在家工作，或是到办公室去，都没有问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xuǎnzé zài jiā gōngzuò, huòshì dào bàngōngshì qù, dōu méiyǒu wèntí.
examples.english: You can choose to work from home or go to the office; either way is fine.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，越来越多的工厂开始使用机器人来提高生产效率。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de gōngchǎng kāishǐ shǐyòng jīqìrén lái tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
examples.english: With the development of technology, more and more factories have started using robots to improve production efficiency.

examples.chinese: 这场火灾造成了很大的经济损失，幸运的是没有人员伤亡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng huǒzāi zàochéngle hěn dà de jīngjì sǔnshī, xìngyùnde shì méiyǒu rényuán shāngyáng.
examples.english: This fire disaster caused significant economic losses, but fortunately there were no casualties.

examples.chinese: 经过几个月的健身训练，他的肌肉变得更加发达了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de jiànshēn xùnliàn, tā de jīròu biàn de gèngjiā fā达le.
examples.english: After several months of fitness training, his muscles became much more developed.

examples.chinese: 这个公司建立了一套完整的激励机制来鼓励员工的创新。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī jiànlìle yī tào wánzhěng de jīlì jīzhì lái gǔlì yuángōng de chuàngxīn.
examples.english: This company has established a complete incentive mechanism to encourage employee innovation.

examples.chinese: 我的退休基金已经积累了不少钱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tuì休 jījīn yǐjīng jīlěi le búshǎo qián.
examples.english: My retirement fund has already accumulated a considerable amount of money.

examples.chinese: 即使天气很冷，他也坚持每天去公园跑步。
examples.pinyin: Jíshǐ tiānqì hěn lěng, tā yě jiānchí měitiān qù gōngyuán pǎobù.
examples.english: Even if the weather is very cold, he still insists on running in the park every day.

examples.chinese: 这个军事基地位于城市的北边，对国家的防御很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jūnshì jīdì wèiyú chéngshì de běibiān, duì guójiā de fángyù hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: This military base is located north of the city and is very important for the country's defense.

examples.chinese: 早上地铁里人太多了，我被挤得喘不过气来。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang dìtiě lǐ rén tàiduō le, wǒ bèi jǐ de chuǎn bu guò qì lái.
examples.english: There were too many people on the subway this morning, and I was squeezed so much that I could barely breathe.

examples.chinese: 我对那次旅行的记忆非常深刻，至今还能记得当时的每个细节。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì nà cì lǚxíng de jìyì fēicháng shēnkè, zhìjīn háinéng jìde dāngshí de měi ge xì节。
examples.english: My memory of that trip is very profound; I can still remember every detail from back then.

examples.chinese: 这个大型集团在全国有超过五千名员工。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàxíng jítuán zài quánguó yǒu chāoguò wǔqiān míng yuángōng.
examples.english: This large group/conglomerate has more than five thousand employees nationwide.

examples.chinese: 冬天时，我们需要加热房间来保持温暖。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān shí, wǒmen xūyào jiārè fángjiān lái bǎochí nuǎnhuо.
examples.english: In winter, we need to heat the room to keep it warm.

examples.chinese: 他继承了父亲的企业，决心要把公司做得更好。
examples.pinyin: Tā jìchéngle fùqin de qǐyè, juéxin yào bǎ gōngsī zuò de gèng hǎo.
examples.english: He inherited his father's business and was determined to make the company even better.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的社会中，掌握多种技能对找工作很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shèhuìzhōng, zhǎngwò duō zhǒng jìnéng duì zhǎo gōngzuò hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: In this highly competitive society, mastering multiple skills is very important for finding a job.

examples.chinese: 他的工作经验丰富，加上他很努力，所以很快就升职了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò jīngyàn fēngfù, jiāshang tā hěn nǔlì, suǒyǐ hěnkuài jiù shēngzhí le.
examples.english: His work experience is abundant, and in addition to that, he works very hard, so he got promoted quickly.

examples.chinese: 随着截止日期的临近，我们必须加速完成这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe ji截zhǐ rìqī de línnjìn, wǒmen bìxū jiāsù wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: As the deadline approaches, we must quicken our pace to complete this project.

examples.chinese: 他夹着公文包匆匆走进了会议室。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāzhe gōngwénbāo cōngcōng zǒujìnle huìyìshì.
examples.english: He hurried into the conference room with a briefcase tucked under his arm.

english: handle; treat (used before polysyllabic verbs or verbal nouns)

examples.chinese: 对于这个问题，我们需要加以重视，不能忽视它的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhège wèntí, wǒmen xūyào jiāyǐ zhòngshì, búnéng hūshì tā de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: Regarding this problem, we need to treat it seriously and cannot ignore its importance.

examples.chinese: 他每天驾驶同样的路线去上班，已经成为了一种习惯。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān jiàshǐ tónyàng de lùxiàn qù shàngbān, yǐjīng chéngwéi le yī zhǒng xíguàn.
examples.english: He drives the same route to work every day, and it has become a habit.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜价比较贵，但是味道确实不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de càijià bǐjiào guì, búguò shìwèi quèshí búcuò.
examples.english: The prices of dishes at this restaurant are quite expensive, but the taste is really good.

examples.chinese: 我在学车，希望下个月能拿到驾照。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéchē, xīwàng xiàge yuè néng ná到 jiàzhào.
examples.english: I'm learning to drive and hope to get my driver's license next month.

examples.chinese: 尽管困难重重，他坚定地相信自己最终会成功。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kùnnan chóngchóng, tā jiāndìng de xiāngxìn zìjǐ zuìzhōng huì chénggōng.
examples.english: Despite numerous difficulties, he firmly believed that he would eventually succeed.

examples.chinese: 这些登山者在艰苦的环境中坚持了三周才到达山顶。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dēngshānzhě zài jiānkǔ de huanjìng zhōng jiānchí le sān zhōu cái dàodá shānding.
examples.english: These climbers persisted for three weeks in arduous conditions before reaching the summit.

examples.chinese: 这个项目进展得很艰难，但我们不会放弃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù jìnzhǎn de hěn jiānnán, dàn wǒmen búhuì fàngqì.
examples.english: This project is progressing with great difficulty, but we won't give up.

examples.chinese: 医生需要检验血液样本来诊断这种疾病。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào jiǎnyàn xuèyè yàngběn lái zhěnduàn zhè zhǒng jíbìng.
examples.english: The doctor needs to test the blood sample to diagnose this disease.

examples.chinese: 这个新政策有助于减轻中小企业的税收负担。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn zhèngcè yǒuzhù yú jiǎnqīng zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de shuìshōu fùdān.
examples.english: This new policy helps lighten the tax burden on small and medium-sized enterprises.

examples.chinese: 他肩上背着一个沉重的背包，走了很久才到达山顶。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiān shang bēizhe yī ge chénzhòng de bēibao, zǒule hěn jiǔ cái dàodá shānding.
examples.english: He carried a heavy backpack on his shoulder and walked for a long time before reaching the mountain top.

examples.chinese: 剪老师今天给我们上了一堂很有趣的历史课。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎoshī jīntiān gěi wǒmen shàngle yī táng hěn yǒuqù de lìshǐ kè.
examples.english: Teacher Jian gave us a very interesting history lesson today.

examples.chinese: 我用剪刀剪断了这根绳子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng jiǎndāo jiǎnduàn le zhè gēn shéngzi.
examples.english: I used scissors to cut this rope.

examples.chinese: 我找不到剪子，能借你的用一下吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎobuzhào jiǎnzi, néng jiè nǐ de yòng yīxià ma?
examples.english: I can't find my clippers. Can I borrow yours for a moment?

examples.chinese: 这个政策间接地影响了很多小企业的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè jiànjiē de yǐngxiǎngle hěnduō xiǎo qǐyè de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: This policy indirectly affected the development of many small businesses.

examples.chinese: 这座大桥花了五年时间才建造完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dà qiáo huāle wǔ nián shíjiān cái jiànzào wánchéng.
examples.english: It took five years to complete the construction of this large bridge.

examples.chinese: 一个健全的法律制度对国家的发展很重要。
examples.pinyin: Yīgè jiànquán de fǎlǜ zhìdù duì guójiā de fāzhǎn hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: A sound legal system is very important for a country's development.

examples.chinese: 在这次比赛中，甲队表现得非常出色，最终赢得了冠军。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì bǐsài zhōng, jiǎ duì biǎoxiàn de fēicháng chūcsè, zuìzh终 yíngdé le guànjūn.
examples.english: In this competition, Team A performed exceptionally well and ultimately won the championship.

examples.chinese: 这座古老的建筑已经有几百年的历史了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de jiànzhù yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: This ancient building has a history of several hundred years.

examples.chinese: 我的笔记本电脑键盘坏了，需要去维修店修一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo jiànpán huài le, xūyào qù wéixiūdiàn xiū yīxià.
examples.english: The keyboard on my laptop is broken and needs to be repaired at a repair shop.

english: key (on a piano or computer keyboard)

examples.chinese: 我不小心按错了键盘上的一个键，结果删除了整个文件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búxiǎoxin àn cuòle jiànpán shang de yīgè jiàn, jiéguǒ shānchúle zhěngge wénjiàn.
examples.english: I accidentally pressed the wrong key on the keyboard, and as a result, I deleted the entire file.

examples.chinese: 明天的会议将在上午十点开始。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān de huìyì jiāng zài shàngwǔ shí diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting is going to start at 10 o'clock in the morning.

examples.chinese: 公司为了奖励员工的努力工作，决定给大家发放年终奖金。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèile jiǎnglì yuángōng de nǔlì gōngzuò, juéding gěi dàjiā fāfàng niánzhōng jiǎngjīn.
examples.english: In order to reward employees for their hard work, the company decided to distribute year-end bonuses to everyone.

examples.chinese: 明天我们将要进行一次重要的会议，请大家做好准备。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān wǒmen jiāngyào jìnxíng yīcì zhòngyào de huìyì, qǐng dàjiā zuòhǎo zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Tomorrow we will hold an important meeting, please everyone be prepared.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的负责人需要向董事会交代工作进展。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de fùzérén xūyào xiàng dǒngshìhuì jiāodài gōngzuò jìnzhǎn.
examples.english: The person in charge of this project needs to report the work progress to the board of directors.

examples.chinese: 这个包装盒破了，我用胶带把它粘好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bāozhuāng hé pò le, wǒ yòng jiāodài bǎ tā zhānhǎo le.
examples.english: The packaging box was torn, so I fixed it with adhesive tape.

examples.chinese: 这个手工艺品坏了，我需要用胶水把它粘回去。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒugōngyìpǐn huài le, wǒ xūyào yòng jiāoshuǐ bǎ tā zhān huíqu.
examples.english: This handicraft broke, and I need to use glue to stick it back together.

examples.chinese: 随着城市发展，越来越多的人搬到郊区去住，因为那里房价比较便宜。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de rén bān dào jiāoqū qù zhù, yīnwèi nàlǐ fángjià bǐjiào piányi.
examples.english: As the city develops, more and more people move to suburban districts to live because the housing prices there are relatively cheaper.

examples.chinese: 听到楼梯上传来的脚步声，我知道妈妈回家了。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào lóutī shang chuánlái de jiǎobù shēng, wǒ zhīdào māma huíjiā le.
examples.english: Hearing the sound of footsteps coming from the stairs, I knew mom had come home.

examples.chinese: 这个月接连发生了几起交通事故，让很多人都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè jiēlián fāshēngle jǐ qǐ jiāotōng shìgù, ràng hěnduō rén dōu hěn dānxīn.
examples.english: Several traffic accidents happened one after another this month, which made many people very worried.

examples.chinese: 医生说我的病情已经稳定了，可以解除隔离了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ de bìngqíng yǐjīng wěndìng le, kěyǐ jiěchú gé离 le.
examples.english: The doctor said my condition has stabilized and I can be released from isolation.

examples.chinese: 在这个项目中，我们有机会接触到最新的技术。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, wǒmen yǒu jīhuì jiēchù dào zuìxīn de jìshù.
examples.english: In this project, we have the opportunity to come into contact with the latest technology.

examples.chinese: 这个新政策解放了很多小企业的发展潜力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn zhèngcè jiěfàng le hěnduō xiǎo qǐyè de fāzhǎn qiánlì.
examples.english: This new policy liberated the development potential of many small enterprises.

examples.chinese: 今年是公司成立的第十届年会，我们邀请了很多重要的客户参加。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián shì gōngsī chénglì de dì shí jiè niánhuì, wǒmen yāoqǐngle hěnduō zhòngyào de kèhù cānjiā.
examples.english: This year is the company's tenth anniversary conference, and we invited many important clients to attend.

examples.chinese: 今日的天气特别好，我们决定去公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Jīnrì de tiānqì tèbié hǎo, wǒmen juédìng qù gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: The weather today is particularly nice, so we decided to take a walk in the park.

examples.chinese: 医生建议他戒掉烟酒，这样才能保持健康。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jiè diào yānjiǔ, zhèyàng cái néng bǎochí jiànkāng.
examples.english: The doctor advised him to keep off cigarettes and alcohol in order to maintain good health.

examples.chinese: 她紧紧地抱住孩子，生怕他走丢了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn de bàozhù háizi, shēngpà tā zǒudiào le.
examples.english: She held the child tightly, afraid that he might get lost.

examples.chinese: 我们尽可能地利用这个机会来改进我们的产品。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jǐnkěnéng de lìyòng zhège jīhuì lái gǎijìn wǒmen de chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: We will utilize this opportunity as far as possible to improve our product.

examples.chinese: 尽管天气很冷，但是他们还是决定去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tiānqì hěn lěng, dànshì tāmen háishi juédìng qù páshān.
examples.english: Even though the weather was very cold, they still decided to go mountain climbing.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，人工智能的能力在不断进化。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, rénggōng zhìnéng de néngliì zài búduàn jìnhuà.
examples.english: As technology develops, the capabilities of artificial intelligence are constantly evolving.

examples.chinese: 近来天气变化很大，我有点感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Jìnlái tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, wǒ yǒudiǎn gǎnmào le.
examples.english: Recently the weather has changed a lot, and I've caught a cold.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的经费不足，我们需要向公司申请额外的预算。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de jīngfèi búzú, wǒmen xūyào xiàng gōngsī shēnqǐng éwài de yùsuàn.
examples.english: The budget for this project is insufficient, so we need to apply to the company for additional funding.

examples.chinese: 早上的公园里，老人们在锻炼身体，孩子们在玩耍，到处是欢乐的景象。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang de gōngyuán lǐ, lǎorénmen zài duànliàn shēntǐ, háizimen zài wánshuǎ, dàochù shì huānlè de jǐngxiàng.
examples.english: In the park in the morning, elderly people are exercising, children are playing, and everywhere there is a joyful scene.

examples.chinese: 医生警告他如果继续抽烟，健康会受到很大的影响。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jǐnggào tā rúguǒ jìxù chōuyān, jiànkāng huì shòudào hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: The doctor warned him that if he continued smoking, his health would be severely affected.

examples.chinese: 这次数学竞赛的难度比去年高了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué jìngsài de náндù bǐ qùnián gāo le hěn duō.
examples.english: The difficulty of this math competition is much higher than last year's.

examples.chinese: 在现代社会，企业之间的竞争越来越激烈。
examples.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèhuì, qǐyè zhījiān de jìngzhēng yuèláiyuè jīliè.
examples.english: In modern society, competition between enterprises is becoming increasingly fierce.

examples.chinese: 政府迅速组织了救灾队伍，帮助受灾地区的人民度过难关。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xùnsù zǔzhī le jiùzāi duìwu, bāngzhù shòujiāi dìqū de rénmín dùguò nánguān.
examples.english: The government quickly organized disaster relief teams to help the people in the affected areas get through this difficult time.

examples.chinese: 他每天都要喝酒，同事们都叫他酒鬼，但他自己从不承认。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu yào hējiǔ, tóngshì men dōu jiào tā jiǔguǐ, dàn tā zìjǐ cóng bu chéngrèn.
examples.english: He drinks every day, and his colleagues all call him a drunkard, but he never admits it himself.

examples.chinese: 他居然没有告诉我就去了北京，我很生气。
examples.pinyin: Tā jūrán méiyǒu gàosu wǒ jiù qù le Běijīng, wǒ hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: He unexpectedly went to Beijing without telling me, and I was very angry.

examples.chinese: 经过几个月的谈判，双方终于扭转了僵持的局面。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de tánpàn, shuāngfāng终于 niǔzhuǎnle jiāngchí de júmiàn.
examples.english: After several months of negotiations, both sides finally turned around the deadlocked situation.

examples.chinese: 这位局长在会议上宣布了新的改革计划。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi júzhǎng zài huìyì shang xuānbù le xīn de gǎigé jìhuà.
examples.english: The bureau chief announced a new reform plan at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 他拒绝了公司的邀请，决定自己创业。
examples.pinyin: Tā jùjué le gōngsī de yāoqǐng, juédìng zìjǐ chuàngyè.
examples.english: He denied the company's invitation and decided to start his own business.

examples.chinese: 我加入了一个摄影俱乐部，每周末都和朋友们一起去拍照。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā入le yīgè shèyǐng jùlèbù, měi zhōumò dōu hé péngyoumen yīqǐ qù pāi zhào.
examples.english: I joined a photography club and go out with friends to take photos every weekend.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的剧本写得非常精彩，我看了好几遍都不厌烦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jùběn xiěde fēicháng jīngcǎi, wǒ kànle hǎo jǐ biàn dōu búyànfán.
examples.english: The script of this movie is written extremely well, and I never get tired of watching it several times.

examples.chinese: 他最近的举动让我们都感到很担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn de jǔdòng ràng wǒmen dōu gǎndào hěn dānxīn.
examples.english: His recent behavior has made all of us feel very worried.

examples.chinese: 经过多次失败后，他感到有些绝望，但最后还是坚持了下来。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì shībài hòu, tā gǎndào yǒuxiē juéwàng, dàn zuìhòu háishi jiānchíle xiàlái.
examples.english: After multiple failures, he felt somewhat hopeless, but in the end he persisted anyway.

examples.chinese: 那位军人在战争中表现得非常勇敢，赢得了许多人的尊敬。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jūnrén zài zhàn zhēng zhōng biǎo xiàn de fēi cháng yǒng gǎn, yíng de le xǔ duō rén de zun jìng.
examples.english: That soldier showed great courage during the war and earned the respect of many people.

examples.chinese: 无论发生什么事，我决不会放弃我的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, wǒ juébù huì fàngqì wǒ de梦想。
examples.english: No matter what happens, I will never give up my dreams.

examples.chinese: 电影节明天就要开幕了，我已经买好了票。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐngjié míngtiān jiù yào kāimù le, wǒ yǐjīng mǎihǎo le piào.
examples.english: The film festival is opening tomorrow, and I've already bought my tickets.

examples.chinese: 奥运会的开幕式吸引了全世界数十亿观众观看。
examples.pinyin: Àoyùnhuì de kāimùshì xīyǐnle quánshìjiè shù shíyì guānzhòng guānkàn.
examples.english: The opening ceremony of the Olympic Games attracted billions of viewers from around the world to watch.

examples.chinese: 很多人把他的沉默看成是不赞成，但实际上他只是在认真思考。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén bǎ tā de chénmò kànchéng shì búzànchéng, dàn shíjìshang tā zhǐshì zài rènzhēn sīkǎo.
examples.english: Many people take his silence as disapproval, but in fact he's just thinking carefully.

examples.chinese: 我们应该用发展的眼光来看待这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi yòng fāzhǎn de yǎnguāng lái kàndài zhège wèntí.
examples.english: We should view this problem from a developmental perspective.

examples.chinese: 从他的表情我能看出他对这个决定不太满意。
examples.pinyin: Cóng tā de biǎoqíng wǒ néng kàn chū tā duì zhège juédìng búntài mǎnyì.
examples.english: From his expression, I can perceive that he is not quite satisfied with this decision.

examples.chinese: 周末我们一家人一起去公园烤肉，孩子们玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen yī jiārén yìqǐ qù gōngyuán kǎoròu, háizimen wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: This weekend, our whole family went to the park for a barbecue together, and the children had a great time.

examples.chinese: 公司每年都会对员工进行考核，以评估他们的工作表现。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měi nián dōu huì duì yuángōng jìnxíng kǎohé, yǐ pínggu tāmen de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The company conducts an annual performance review of its employees to evaluate their work performance.

examples.chinese: 当我靠近那个古老的建筑时，我才注意到墙上精美的雕刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ kàojìn nàge gǔlǎo de jiànzhù shí, wǒ cái zhùyìdào qiáng shang jīngměi de diāokè.
examples.english: When I came near the ancient building, I only then noticed the exquisite carvings on the wall.

examples.chinese: 北京烤鸭是中国最著名的菜肴之一，很多游客来北京都想尝一尝正宗的烤鸭。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng kǎoyā shì Zhōngguó zuì zhùmíng de càiyao zhī yī, hěnduō yóukè lái Běijīng dōu xiǎng chángyichang zhèngzōng de kǎoyā.
examples.english: Peking roast duck is one of the most famous dishes in China, and many tourists who come to Beijing want to try authentic roast duck.

examples.chinese: 听到这个消息后，他咳了一声，然后沉默地走开了。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu, tā hāile yī shēng, ránhòu chénmò de zǒukāile.
examples.english: After hearing this news, he sighed heavily and then walked away in silence.

examples.chinese: 这颗苹果又大又甜，是我吃过最好吃的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē píngguǒ yòu dà yòu tián, shì wǒ chīguo zuì hǎochī de.
examples.english: This apple is both big and sweet, it's the best one I've ever eaten.

examples.chinese: 看到那个可怜的小孩在街上乞讨，我忍不住给了他一些钱。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào nàge kělián de xiǎoháizi zài jiēshang qǐtǎo, wǒ rěnbuzhù gěile tā yīxiē qián.
examples.english: Seeing that pitiful child begging on the street, I couldn't help but give him some money.

examples.chinese: 这个问题可能没有完美的答案。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí kěnéng méiyǒu wánměi de dáàn.
examples.english: This problem probably doesn't have a perfect answer.

examples.chinese: 他本来可以考上那所大学，但是生病了，可惜了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běnlái kěyǐ kǎoshàng nàsuǒ dàxué, búguò shēngbìng le, kěxī le.
examples.english: He could have gotten into that university, but he got sick. What a pity.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的努力工作，他终于实现了自己一直渴望的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì gōngzuò, tā zh終于 shíxiàn le zìjǐ yīzhí kěwàng de梦想。
examples.english: After years of hard work, he finally realized the dream he had always yearned for.

examples.chinese: 我们公司最近失去了一个重要的客户，所以销售团队正在努力开发新的市场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zuìjìn shīqùle yīge zhòngyào de kèhù, suǒyǐ xiāoshòu tuánduì zhèngzài nǔlì kāifā xīn de shìchǎng.
examples.english: Our company recently lost an important client, so the sales team is working hard to develop new markets.

examples.chinese: 他每天都刻苦学习，希望能考上理想的大学。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu kèkǔ xuéxí, xīwàng néng kǎo shang lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
examples.english: He studies diligently every day, hoping to get into his ideal university.

examples.chinese: 你不用客气，我们都是朋友，想吃什么就直接告诉我。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng kèqi, wǒmen dōu shì péngyou, xiǎng chī shénme jiù zhíjiē gàosu wǒ.
examples.english: You don't need to be polite; we're all friends, just tell me directly what you want to eat.

examples.chinese: 这个课题研究了很多年，终于有了突破。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kètí yánjiūle hěnduō nián,终于 yǒule túpò.
examples.english: This research project has been studied for many years and finally made a breakthrough.

examples.chinese: 我们在客厅里看了一整晚上的电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài kètīng lǐ kànle yī zhěng wǎnshang de diànyǐng.
examples.english: We watched movies in the living room for the whole evening.

examples.chinese: 飞机在空中飞行时，乘客可以欣赏到美丽的云景。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī zài kōngzhōng fēixíng shí, chéngkè kěyǐ欣赏 dào měilì de yúnjǐng.
examples.english: When the airplane is flying in the air, passengers can enjoy the beautiful cloud scenery.

examples.chinese: 这个公司的口号是'创新改变生活'，员工们都很认同这个理念。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de kǒuhào shì 'chuàngxīn gǎibiàn shēnghuó', yuángōngmen dōu hěn rèngtóng zhège lǐniàn.
examples.english: This company's motto is 'Innovation Changes Life,' and all employees agree with this concept.

examples.chinese: 公司需要加强对成本的控制，才能提高利润。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào jiāqiáng duì chéngběn de kòngzhì, cáinéng tígāo lìrùn.
examples.english: The company needs to strengthen cost control in order to increase profits.

examples.chinese: 他的努力肯定会得到回报，只是时间问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā de nǔlì kěndìng huì huòdào huíbào, zhǐshì shíjiān wèntí.
examples.english: His hard work will definitely be rewarded, it's just a matter of time.

examples.chinese: 公司的仓库里存放了大量的货物，需要派人定期检查。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de cāngkù lǐ cúnfàng le dàliàng de huòwù, xūyào pāi rén dìngqī jiǎnchá.
examples.english: The company's warehouse stores a large amount of goods and requires people to inspect it regularly.

examples.chinese: 周末和朋友们一起去爬山，我们玩得很快活。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò hé péngyoumen yīqǐ qù páshān, wǒmen wán de hěn kuàihuo.
examples.english: We went hiking with friends on the weekend and had a great time.

examples.chinese: 他对足球的热情非常狂热，每场比赛都不会错过。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zúqiú de règíng fēicháng kuángrè, měi chǎng bǐsài dōu búhuì cuòguò.
examples.english: He is extremely passionate about football and never misses a single match.

examples.chinese: 这条河的宽度大约有一百米，在雨季会变得更宽。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de kuāndù dàyuē yǒu yībǎi mǐ, zài yǔjì huì biàn de gèng kuān.
examples.english: The width of this river is approximately one hundred meters, and it becomes even wider during the rainy season.

examples.chinese: 叶子从树上落下来，铺满了整个院子。
examples.pinyin: Yèzi cóng shù shang luò xiàlái, pù mǎn le zhěngge yuànzi.
examples.english: Leaves fell from the trees and covered the entire courtyard.

examples.chinese: 这个问题一直困扰着我，我不知道应该怎么解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yìzhí kùnrǎo zhe wǒ, wǒ búzhīdào yīnggāi zěnyàng jiějué.
examples.english: This problem has been perplexing me, and I don't know how to solve it.

examples.chinese: 这家公司今年亏了很多钱，所以不得不裁员。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jīnnián kuī le hěnduō qián, suǒyǐ búděbù cáiyuán.
examples.english: This company lost a lot of money this year, so it had to lay off employees.

examples.chinese: 我已经收到了你的来信，感谢你的问候。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng shōudào le nǐ de láixìn, gǎnxiè nǐ de wènhòu.
examples.english: I have already received your letter and thank you for your regards.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的剧情太烂了，我看到一半就走出了电影院。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jùqing tài làn le, wǒ kàndào yībàn jiù zǒuchūle diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.english: The plot of this movie is terrible. I walked out of the cinema halfway through.

examples.chinese: 老师要求学生们在课堂上朗读课文，这样可以提高他们的发音。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshengmen zài kètáng shang lǎngdú kèwén, zhèyàng kěyǐ tígāo tāmen de fāyīn.
examples.english: The teacher requires students to read the text aloud in class, which can improve their pronunciation.

examples.chinese: 他年轻时很浪漫，经常花天酒地，后来才慢慢改变了。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí hěn làngmàn, jīngcháng huā tiān jiǔ dì, hòulái cái mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: When he was young, he was dissolute and often indulged in a life of debauchery, but he gradually changed later.

examples.chinese: 这个梨又甜又多汁，是我吃过最好吃的水果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lí yòu tián yòu duō zhī, shì wǒ chīguo zuì hǎochī de shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: This pear is both sweet and juicy; it's the most delicious fruit I've ever eaten.

examples.chinese: 他每天都在工地上进行繁重的劳动，挣钱养家。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài gōngdì shang jìnxíng fánzhòng de láodong, zhuànqián yǎng jiā.
examples.english: He does heavy labor at the construction site every day to earn money and support his family.

examples.chinese: 下礼拜我们公司要举办一个重要的会议，所有员工都必须参加。
examples.pinyin: Xià lǐbài wǒmen gōngsī yào jǔbàn yī ge zhòngyào de huìyì, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu bìxū cānjiā.
examples.english: Next week our company is going to hold an important meeting, and all employees must attend.

examples.chinese: 在中国文化中，礼貌待人是一种重要的品质，能帮助我们建立良好的人际关系。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó wénhuà zhōng, lǐmào dàirén shì yī zhǒng zhòngyào de pǐnzhì, néng bāngzhù wǒmen jiànlì liánghǎo de rénjì guānxi.
examples.english: In Chinese culture, treating people with courtesy is an important quality that helps us build good interpersonal relationships.

examples.chinese: 他送了我一份很贵重的礼，我不好意思收。
examples.pinyin: Tā sòngle wǒ yī fèn hěn guìzhòng de lǐ, wǒ búhǎo yìsi shōu.
examples.english: He gave me a very valuable gift, and I felt embarrassed to accept it.

examples.chinese: 这个学生的数学成绩真的很厉害，每次考试都是全班第一。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuésheng de shùxué chéngjī zhēnde hěn lìhai, měi cì kǎoshì dōu shì quánbān dì yī.
examples.english: This student's math grades are really impressive; he always ranks first in the class on every exam.

examples.chinese: 从不同的立场来看，这个问题有不同的答案。
examples.pinyin: Cóng búhuà de lìchǎng lái kàn, zhège wèntí yǒu búhuà de dáàn.
examples.english: From different perspectives, this question has different answers.

examples.chinese: 这家公司去年的利润增长了百分之三十。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī qùnián de lìrùn zēngzhǎngle bǎifēnzhī sānshí.
examples.english: The company's profit increased by thirty percent last year.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的服务质量一直很好，今天的情况是个例外。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù zhìliàng yīzhí hěn hǎo, jīntiān de qíngkuàng shì ge lìwài.
examples.english: This restaurant's service quality has always been good; today's situation is an exception.

examples.chinese: 这个新项目连接了公司的三个不同部门。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn xiàngmù liánjiēle gōngsī de sān ge búTóng bùmén.
examples.english: This new project connected the company's three different departments.

english: abbr. for 聯想集團|联想集团[Lian2 xiang3 Ji2 tuan2]

examples.chinese: 我用的笔记本电脑是联想的，性价比很不错。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng de bǐjìběn diànnǎo shì Liánxiǎng de, xìngjià bǐ hěn búcuò.
examples.english: The laptop I use is a Lenovo, and it has excellent value for money.

examples.chinese: 我们需要加强与客户的联络，以便更好地了解他们的需求。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jiāqiáng yǔ kèhù de liánluò, yǐbiàn gèng hǎo de liǎojiě tāmen de xūqiú.
examples.english: We need to strengthen contact with our clients so we can better understand their needs.

examples.chinese: 这家公司是在十年前立的，现在已经成为行业的领头羊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì zài shí nián qián lì de, xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéi hángyè de lǐngtóu yáng.
examples.english: This company was founded ten years ago and has now become a leader in the industry.

examples.chinese: 浴室里的脸盆很脏，我需要好好清洗一下。
examples.pinyin: Yùshì lǐ de liǎnpén hěn zāng, wǒ xūyào hǎohāo qīngxǐ yīxià.
examples.english: The washbowl in the bathroom is quite dirty; I need to clean it thoroughly.

examples.chinese: 他们在大学期间开始恋爱，现在已经结婚三年了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài dàxué qījiān kāishǐ liànài, xiànzài yǐjīng jiéhūn sān nián le.
examples.english: They started dating during university, and they've been married for three years now.

examples.chinese: 这条河的两岸都种满了柳树，春天的时候非常漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de liǎngàn dōu zhòngmǎn le liǔshù, chūntiān de shíhou fēicháng piàoliang.
examples.english: Both sides of this river are planted with willow trees, which look very beautiful in spring.

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息后，脸色立刻变得很难看。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, liǎnsè lìkè biànde hěn nánkàn.
examples.english: After hearing this news, his face immediately became very dark/grim.

examples.chinese: 我在开会的时候听到了手机的铃声，但我没有接电话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài kāihuì de shíhou tīngdàole shǒujī de língshēng, dàn wǒ méiyǒu jiē diànhuà.
examples.english: I heard the ring of my phone while I was in a meeting, but I didn't answer the call.

examples.chinese: 我的邻居最近搬家了，他们去了南方工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū zuìjìn bānjiā le, tāmen qù le nánfāng gōngzuò.
examples.english: My neighbor moved recently and went to work in the south.

examples.chinese: 他穿着深蓝色的西装，配上一条红色的领带，看起来非常专业。
examples.pinyin: Tā穿着深蓝色的西装，配上一条红色的领带，看起来非常专业。
examples.english: He wore a dark blue suit with a red necktie, and looked very professional.

examples.chinese: 这个消息令我感到很惊讶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxī lìng wǒ gǎndào hěn jīngyà.
examples.english: This news made me feel very surprised.

examples.chinese: 城市里人口的流动越来越频繁，很多年轻人都想到大城市去发展。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì lǐ rénkǒu de liúdòng yuèláiyuè pí繁pín, hěnduō niánqīngrén dōu xiǎng dào dà chéngshì qù fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The flow of population in cities is becoming increasingly frequent, with many young people wanting to develop their careers in big cities.

examples.chinese: 下课铃声响了，学生们纷纷收拾书包准备离开教室。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè líng shēng xiǎng le, xuéshengmen fēnfēn shōushí shūbāo zhǔnbèi líkāi jiàoshì.
examples.english: The school bell rang, and students quickly packed up their bags and prepared to leave the classroom.

examples.chinese: 这种新的支付方式在市场上流通得很快，越来越多的人开始使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn de zhīfù fāngshì zài shìchǎng shang liútōng de hěn kuài, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: This new payment method circulates very quickly in the market, and more and more people are starting to use it.

examples.chinese: 这个软件有个严重的漏洞，黑客可以通过它进入系统。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn yǒu ge yánzhòng de lòudòng, heikè kěyǐ tōngguò tā jìnrù xìtǒng.
examples.english: This software has a serious vulnerability through which hackers can enter the system.

examples.chinese: 昨天下雨的时候，我才发现屋顶漏水了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xiàyǔ de shíhou, wǒ cái fāxiàn wūdǐng lòushuǐ le.
examples.english: It wasn't until it rained yesterday that I discovered the roof was leaking.

examples.chinese: 这个论证的逻辑不太清楚，我需要再想想。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùnzhèng de luóji búcuò qīngchu, wǒ xūyào zài xiǎngxiang.
examples.english: The logic of this argument isn't very clear; I need to think about it more.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的预算还没有落实，我们需要尽快确认具体的数字。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn háishi méiyǒu luòshí, wǒmen xūyào jìnkuài quèrèn jùtǐ de shùzì.
examples.english: The budget for this project hasn't been finalized yet, and we need to confirm the specific figures as soon as possible.

examples.chinese: 我们在码头等了很久，船才慢慢靠岸。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài mǎtou děng le hěn jiǔ, chuán cái màn man kào'àn.
examples.english: We waited at the dock for a long time before the ship finally pulled in slowly.

examples.chinese: 这个商人的买卖做得很成功，他已经开了五家分店。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shāngrén de mǎimai zuò de hěn chénggōng, tā yǐjīng kāi le wǔ jiā fēn店。
examples.english: This businessman's trade has been very successful; he has already opened five branch stores.

examples.chinese: 这个漫长的冬天终于要结束了，春天就要来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège màncháng de dōngtiān zh終yú yào jiéshù le, chūntiān jiù yào lái le.
examples.english: This long winter is finally coming to an end, and spring is about to arrive.

examples.chinese: 他用毛笔在宣纸上写了一首古诗，笔画流畅而有力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng máobǐ zài xuānzhǐ shang xiěle yī shǒu gǔshī, bǐhuà liúchàng érháoyǒu lì.
examples.english: He wrote an ancient poem on rice paper with a writing brush, and the strokes were smooth and powerful.

examples.chinese: 这部漫画改编成的电视剧非常受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù mànhuà gǎibiàn chéng de diànshìjù fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The TV series adapted from this manga is very popular.

examples.chinese: 他冒着雨去医院看望生病的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā màozhe yǔ qù yīyuàn kànwàng shēngbìng de péngyou.
examples.english: He risked going out in the rain to visit his sick friend at the hospital.

examples.chinese: 他的话很矛盾，先说喜欢这个工作，后来又说想辞职。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huà hěn máodùn, xiān説xǐhuān zhège gōngzuò, hòuláI yòu shuō xiǎng cízhí.
examples.english: His words were contradictory—first he said he liked this job, but later he said he wanted to quit.

examples.chinese: 他迟到了一个小时，被老板狠狠地骂了一顿。
examples.pinyin: Tā chídào le yī ge xiǎoshí, bèi lǎobǎn hěnhěn de mà le yī dùn.
examples.english: He was an hour late and got chewed out by his boss.

examples.chinese: 中国和美国之间的贸易关系非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó hé Měiguó zhījiān de màoyì guānxi fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: The trade relationship between China and the United States is very important.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂主要用煤来发电，但他们计划逐步转向清洁能源。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhǔyào yòng méi lái fādiàn, dàn tāmen jìhuà逐步 zhuǎnxiàng qīngjié néngliàng.
examples.english: This factory mainly uses coal to generate electricity, but they plan to gradually shift toward clean energy.

examples.chinese: 厨房里的煤气泄漏了，我们赶紧打开窗户通风。
examples.pinyin: Chúfāng lǐ de méiqì xièlòu le, wǒmen gǎnjǐn dǎkāi chuānghù tōngfēng.
examples.english: The coal gas in the kitchen leaked, so we quickly opened the windows to ventilate.

examples.chinese: 我明天要去医院门诊挂号，因为最近一直感觉不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào qù yīyuàn ménzhěn guàhào, yīnwèi zuìjìn yīzhí gǎnjuéde búshūfu.
examples.english: I need to go to the hospital's outpatient clinic to register tomorrow because I haven't been feeling well lately.

examples.chinese: 有些老人迷信风水，搬家的时候都要请风水师来看一下。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē lǎorén míxìn fēngshuǐ, bānjiā de shíhou dōu yào qǐng fēngshuǐ shī lái kàn yīxià.
examples.english: Some elderly people have blind faith in feng shui, and they always hire a feng shui master to take a look when they move.

examples.chinese: 改革开放以来，中国城市的面貌发生了巨大的变化。
examples.pinyin: Gǎigé kāifàng yǐlái, Zhōngguó chéngshì de miànmào fāshēngle jùdà de biànhuà.
examples.english: Since the reform and opening up, the appearance of Chinese cities has undergone tremendous changes.

examples.chinese: 这个古镇有着迷人的风景和悠久的历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔzhèn yǒuzhe mírén de fēngjǐng hé yōujiǔ de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This ancient town has enchanting scenery and a long history.

examples.chinese: 这个运动员在100米比赛中只用了9秒8的时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yùndòngyuán zài 100 mǐ bǐsài zhōng zhǐ yòngle 9 miǎo 8 de shíjiān.
examples.english: This athlete completed the 100-meter race in just 9.8 seconds.

examples.chinese: 她对音乐有敏感的耳朵，能听出最细微的音差。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè yǒu mǐngǎn de ěrduǒ, néng tīng chū zuì xìwēi de yīnchā.
examples.english: She has a sensitive ear for music and can detect the subtlest differences in pitch.

examples.chinese: 这间办公室的窗户很大，所以光线特别明亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān bàngōngshì de chuānghu hěn dà, suǒyǐ guāngxiàn tèbié míngliàng.
examples.english: This office has large windows, so the lighting is particularly bright.

examples.chinese: 在这个重要的会议上出了错误，他觉得很丢面子。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège zhòngyào de huìyì shang chūle cuòwù, tā juéde hěn diū miànzi.
examples.english: He felt very embarrassed after making a mistake at this important meeting.

examples.chinese: 他明明知道这个决定是错的，但还是坚持己见。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngmíng zhīdào zhège juédìng shì cuò de, dàn háishi jiānchí jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: He obviously knew that this decision was wrong, but he still insisted on his own opinion.

examples.chinese: 经理命令我们必须在周五之前完成这个项目。
examples.pinyin: jīnglǐ mìnglìng wǒmen bìxū zài zhōuwǔ zhīqián wánchéng zhège xiàngmù。
examples.english: The manager ordered us to complete this project before Friday.

examples.chinese: 这个演员模仿了那位著名导演的说话风格，引得观众大笑。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǎnyuán mófǎngle nàwèi zhùmíng dǎoyǎn de shuōhuà fēnggé, yǐnde guānzhòng dàxiào.
examples.english: The actor imitated the speaking style of that famous director, which made the audience laugh loudly.

examples.chinese: 李老师是我们学校最受尊敬的模范教师，他的课堂总是充满了生动的教学方法。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī shì wǒmen xuéxiào zuì shòu zūnjìng de mófàn jiàoshī, tā de kètáng zǒngshì chōngmǎn le shēngdòng de jiàoxué fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Teacher Li is the most respected model teacher in our school, and his classes are always full of vivid teaching methods.

examples.chinese: 由于灯光昏暗，我看不清楚那幅画的细节，只能看到一个模糊的轮廓。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú dēngguāng hōng'àn, wǒ kànbuqīngchu nà fú huà de xì節, zhǐnéng kàndào yīgè móhu de lúnkuò.
examples.english: Due to the dim lighting, I couldn't see the details of that painting clearly, and could only make out a blurry outline.

examples.chinese: 这家公司采用了一种新的商业模式，效果非常好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī cǎiyòngle yī zhǒng xīn de shāngyè móshì, xiàoguǒ fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: This company adopted a new business model, and the results are very good.

examples.chinese: 两个国家之间的贸易摩擦最近引起了很多关注。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge guójiā zhījiān de màoyì mócā zuìjìn yǐnqǐle hěnduō guānzhù.
examples.english: The trade friction between the two countries has recently attracted a lot of attention.

examples.chinese: 他骑着摩托车在城市里穿梭，速度很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā qìzhe mótuōchē zài chéngshì lǐ chuānsuō, sùdù hěn kuài.
examples.english: He weaves through the city on his motorcycle, going very fast.

examples.chinese: 从他疲惫的模样来看，这个项目显然花了他很多精力。
examples.pinyin: Cóng tā píbeì de múyàng lái kàn, zhège xiàngmù xiǎnrán huāle tā hěnduō jīnglì.
examples.english: Judging from his exhausted appearance, this project has clearly taken a lot of his energy.

examples.chinese: 她的目光落在窗外的风景上，似乎在思考什么重要的事情。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mùguāng luòzài chuāngwài de fēngjǐng shang, sìhū zài sīkǎo shénme zhòngyào de shìqing.
examples.english: Her gaze fell upon the scenery outside the window, as if she was thinking about something important.

examples.chinese: 这个公司的男性员工比女性员工多得多。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de nánxìng yuángōng bǐ nǚxìng yuángōng duō de duō.
examples.english: The male employees at this company are much more numerous than the female employees.

examples.chinese: 这条高速公路连接了南北方，大大缩短了两地之间的距离。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gāosù gōnglù liánjiē le nánběi fāng, dàdà suōduǎn le liǎng dì zhījiān de jùlí.
examples.english: This expressway connects the north and south regions, greatly shortening the distance between the two areas.

examples.chinese: 学习一门新的语言需要很多耐心和坚持。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yī mén xīn de yǔyán xūyào hěnduō nàixīn hé jiānchí.
examples.english: Learning a new language requires a lot of patience and persistence.

examples.chinese: 科学家们在南极发现了一些新的企鹅物种。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men zài nánjí fāxiàn le yīxiē xīn de qǐ'é wùzhǒng.
examples.english: Scientists discovered some new species of penguins in Antarctica.

examples.chinese: 这样的好天气难得一见，我们今天一定要去公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de hǎo tiānqì nándé yī jiàn, wǒmen jīntiān yīdìng yào qù gōngyuán sǎnbù.
examples.english: Such beautiful weather is hard to come by, so we must go for a walk in the park today.

examples.chinese: 这个问题难以解决，需要更多的时间和资源。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí nányǐ jiějué, xūyào gèngduō de shíjiān hé zīyuán.
examples.english: This problem is difficult to solve and requires more time and resources.

examples.chinese: 这个项目需要大量的时间和能量来完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào dàliàng de shíjiān hé néngliàng lái wánchéng.
examples.english: This project requires a lot of time and energy to complete.

examples.chinese: 这个产品的质量问题反映了公司内在的管理缺陷。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng wèntí fǎnyìngle gōngsī nèizài de guǎnlǐ quēxiàn.
examples.english: The quality problems of this product reflect the company's inherent management defects.

examples.chinese: 我姐姐今年的年龄是二十五岁，她已经开始考虑结婚的事情了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie jīnnián de niánlíng shì èrshíwǔ suì, tā yǐjīng kāishǐ kǎolǜ jiéhūn de shìqing le.
examples.english: My older sister is twenty-five years old this year, and she has already started thinking about getting married.

examples.chinese: 今年度的销售目标比去年提高了百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Jīn niándù de xiāoshòu mùbiāo bǐ qùnián tíhuàle bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
examples.english: This year's sales target has increased by twenty percent compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 我三年前从北京搬到了上海，现在已经很适应这个城市了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sān nián qián cóng Běijīng bāndào le Shànghǎi, xiànzài yǐjīng hěn shìyìng zhège chéngshì le.
examples.english: I moved to Shanghai from Beijing three years ago, and I'm already quite adapted to this city now.

examples.chinese: 你得好好用脑子想想，这个问题没有那么简单。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi hǎohāo yòng nǎozi xiǎngxiang, zhège wèntí méiyǒu nàme jiǎndān.
examples.english: You really need to use your brain and think about it—this problem isn't that simple.

examples.chinese: 这条牛仔裤的质量很好，我已经穿了三年了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo niúzǎikù de zhìliàng hěn hǎo, wǒ yǐjīng chuānle sān nián le.
examples.english: This pair of jeans has great quality; I've been wearing them for three years already.

examples.chinese: 这个农民养了十多头牛，每天都要花很多时间照顾它们。
examples.pinyin: Zhège nóngmín yǎngle shí duō tóu niú, měi tiān dōu yào huā hěn duō shíjiān zhàogu tāmen.
examples.english: This farmer raises more than ten cattle and has to spend a lot of time caring for them every day.

examples.chinese: 这个地区的农产品主要销售到大城市。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de nóngchǎnpǐn zhǔyào xiāoshòu dào dà chéngshì.
examples.english: The agricultural products from this region are mainly sold to major cities.

examples.chinese: 这个冬天特别冷，我很想念家里那盏暖和的灯。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dōngtiān tèbié lěng, wǒ hěn xiǎngniàn jiāli nà zhàn nuǎnhuo de dēng.
examples.english: This winter is especially cold, and I really miss that warm lamp at home.

examples.chinese: 现在越来越多的女性选择在职场上发展自己的事业。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de nǚxìng xuǎnzé zài zhíchǎng shang fāzhǎn zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Nowadays, more and more women choose to develop their careers in the workplace.

examples.chinese: 我偶然在街上遇见了一位多年没见的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ǒurán zài jiēshang yùjiàn le yī wèi duō nián méi jiàn de lǎo péngyou.
examples.english: I accidentally ran into an old friend on the street whom I hadn't seen for many years.

examples.chinese: 很多年轻人把明星当作自己的偶像，希望能像他们一样成功。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīngrén bǎ míngxīng dāngzuò zìjǐ de ǒuxiàng, xīwàng néng xiàng tāmen yīyàng chénggōng.
examples.english: Many young people regard celebrities as their idols and hope to be as successful as them.

examples.chinese: 我平时很忙，偶尔才有时间去看看电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngshí hěn máng, ǒuěr cái yǒu shíjiān qù kànkan diànyǐng.
examples.english: I'm usually very busy, and only once in a blue moon do I have time to watch a movie.

examples.chinese: 我们需要排除所有的可能性，才能找到真正的原因。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào páichú suǒyǒu de kěnéngxìng, cáinéng zhǎodào zhēnzhèng de yuányīn.
examples.english: We need to eliminate all possibilities in order to find the real cause.

examples.chinese: 这部电影是去年在北京拍摄的，花了将近一年的时间才完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì qùnián zài Běijīng pāishè de, huāle jiāngjìn yī nián de shíjiān cái wánchéng.
examples.english: This film was shot in Beijing last year and took nearly a year to complete.

examples.chinese: 这个周末我想陪父母去公园散步。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ xiǎng péi fùmǔ qù gōngyuán sǎnbù.
examples.english: This weekend I want to accompany my parents to the park for a walk.

examples.chinese: 这次事故是我的责任，我会赔偿你所有的损失。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù shì wǒ de zérèn, wǒ huì péicháng nǐ suǒyǒu de sǔnshī.
examples.english: This accident is my responsibility, and I will compensate you for all your losses.

examples.chinese: 公司因为产品质量问题向客户赔偿了一大笔钱。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yīnwèi chǎnpǐn zhìliàng wèntí xiàng kèhù péicháng le yī dà bǐ qián.
examples.english: The company compensated customers with a large sum of money due to product quality issues.

examples.chinese: 这家公司为所有员工配备了最新的电脑和软件。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī wèi suǒyǒu yuángōng pèibèi le zuìxīn de diànnǎo hé ruǎnjiàn.
examples.english: This company equipped all employees with the latest computers and software.

examples.chinese: 在咖啡馆旁边有一家新开的书店，我经常去那里看书。
examples.pinyin: Zài kāfēiguǎn pángbiān yǒu yī jiā xīn kāi de shūdiàn, wǒ jīngcháng qù nàlǐ kànshū.
examples.english: Next to the coffee shop, there's a newly opened bookstore where I often go to read.

examples.chinese: 这个办公楼配套了停车场、食堂和健身房，员工的工作环境改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bàngōngshì pèi tàole tíngchēchǎng, shítáng hé jiànshēnfáng, yuángōng de gōngzuò huanjìng gǎishàn le hěnduō.
examples.english: This office building comes with a complete set of facilities including a parking lot, cafeteria, and gym, which greatly improved the employees' working environment.

examples.chinese: 洗车的时候，水管喷出来的水花溅了我一身。
examples.pinyin: xǐchē de shíhou, shuǐguǎn pēn chūlái de shuǐhuā jiàn le wǒ yì shēn.
examples.english: When washing the car, the water splashing out from the hose got all over me.

examples.chinese: 妈妈在厨房里用一个大盆洗蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Māma zài chúfang lǐ yòng yī ge dà pén xǐ shūcài.

examples.chinese: 我认识他很多年了，但从来没有真正认识过他的想法。

examples.chinese: 他认定这个项目能成功，所以决定投入所有的资金。

examples.chinese: 我已经忍受了三年的长距离恋爱，现在终于可以和他住在一起了。

examples.chinese: 虽然已经毕业了，他仍旧经常回学校看望老师。

examples.chinese: 他的声音如同春风一样温暖，让人感到很舒服。

examples.english: His voice is like the spring breeze, warm and comforting.

examples.chinese: 这个软件可以帮助我们提高工作效率。

examples.chinese: 这个项目的主要目标如下：提高生产效率、降低成本和改善产品质量。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de zhǔyào mùbiāo rúxià: tíngāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ, jiàngdī chéngběn hé gǎishàn chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
examples.english: The main objectives of this project are as follows: to improve production efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality.

examples.chinese: 这张床的垫子太软了，我睡得很舒服。

examples.english: The mattress on this bed is too soft, and I sleep very comfortably.

examples.chinese: 我的电脑感染了病毒，我立即安装了杀毒软件来保护我的数据。

examples.chinese: 这个新政策有效地杀死了市场上的虚假广告。

examples.english: This new policy effectively eliminated false advertisements in the market.

examples.chinese: 我们在沙漠里迷路了，幸好找到了一个绿洲。

examples.chinese: 这位作家写的散文很受欢迎，因为他能把日常生活写得非常有趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā xiě de sǎnwén hěn shòu huānyíng, yīnwèi tā néng bǎ rìcháng shēnghuó xiě de fēicháng yǒuqù.
examples.english: The prose written by this author is very popular because he can write everyday life in a very interesting way.

examples.chinese: 这个山区的交通很不方便，村民们很难到城里去。

examples.english: The transportation in this mountain area is very inconvenient, making it difficult for villagers to go to the city.

examples.chinese: 他傻傻地笑了，完全不在乎别人的看法。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǎshǎ de xiào le, wánquán búzàihu biérén de kànfǎ.
examples.english: He laughed stupidly, completely not caring about what others thought.

examples.chinese: 夏天太热了，我买了一把电扇放在卧室里。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān tài rè le, wǒ mǎi le yī bǎ diànshàn fàng zài wòshì lǐ.
examples.english: It's too hot in summer, so I bought an electric fan and put it in my bedroom.

examples.chinese: 夏天的时候，我奶奶经常坐在院子里，拿着一把扇子慢慢摇。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, wǒ nǎinai jīngcháng zuòzai yuànzi li, názhe yībǎ shànzi màiman yáo.
examples.english: During summer, my grandmother often sits in the courtyard and slowly fans herself with a fan.

examples.chinese: 这个品牌的商标设计得很独特，在市场上很容易被消费者认出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái de shāngbiāo shèjì de hěn dútè, zài shìchǎng shang hěn róngyì bèi xiāofèizhě rènchūlái.
examples.english: This brand's trademark is designed very uniquely, making it easy for consumers to recognize it in the market.

examples.chinese: 这个决定需要先向上级报告，才能正式实施。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juéding xūyào xiān xiàng shàngjí bàogào, cáinéng zhèngshì shíshī.
examples.english: This decision needs to be reported to the higher authority first before it can be officially implemented.

examples.chinese: 这栋楼上下都住满了人，每天都很热闹。

examples.english: This building is packed with people from top to bottom, and it's lively every day.

examples.chinese: 最近房价又上涨了，很多年轻人都买不起房子。

examples.english: House prices have risen again recently, and many young people can't afford to buy homes.

examples.chinese: 这道菜稍微有点辣，你能吃吗？

examples.english: This dish is kind of spicy. Can you eat it?

examples.chinese: 在非洲草原上，我们看到了一条很长的蛇在草丛里慢慢地爬动。
examples.pinyin: Zài fēizhōu cǎoyuán shang, wǒmen kàndào le yī tiáo hěn cháng de shé zài cǎocōng li màanman de pádonɡ.
examples.english: On the African savanna, we saw a very long snake slowly crawling through the grass.

examples.chinese: 这个问题有点复杂，我需要稍微思考一下才能给你答案。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǒudiǎn fùzá, wǒ xūyào shāowēi sīkǎo yīxià cái néng gěi nǐ dáàn.
examples.english: This question is a bit complicated. I need to think about it a little bit before I can give you an answer.

examples.chinese: 她舍不得扔掉那件旧衣服，因为它承载了很多美好的回忆。
examples.pinyin: Tā shěbude扔diào nà jiàn jiù yīfu, yīnwèi tā chéngzàile hěnduō měihǎo de huíyì.

examples.chinese: 这个软件可以自动生成报告，节省了我们很多时间。

examples.english: This software can automatically generate reports, which saves us a lot of time.

examples.chinese: 最近油价又升高了，很多人都在抱怨。

examples.english: Oil prices have risen again recently, and many people are complaining about it.

examples.chinese: 他突然大声喊了一句，把我们都吓了一跳。

examples.english: He suddenly shouted loudly, which startled all of us.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的故事情节非常神奇，我看了三遍还想再看。

examples.english: The plot of this movie is really magical; I've watched it three times and still want to watch it again.

examples.chinese: 这场比赛的胜负取决于双方的临场表现。

examples.english: The victory or defeat in this match depends on both teams' on-field performance.

examples.english: The meeting has been going on for three hours already; we'll continue discussing the remaining topics tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 这次比赛中，球队因为一个小失误就输掉了最后的胜利。

examples.english: In this match, the team lost the final victory because of a small mistake.

examples.chinese: 这位师傅在这家餐厅已经做了二十年的菜，手艺特别好。

examples.english: This master chef has been cooking at this restaurant for twenty years, and his skills are particularly excellent.

examples.chinese: 她对古代诗歌的热爱让我印象深刻，经常能背诵很多经典作品。

examples.chinese: 他时常在周末去公园散步，这已经成为他的习惯了。

examples.english: He often goes for a walk in the park on weekends, and it has become his habit.

examples.chinese: 他对这个项目的热情十足，每天都工作到很晚。

examples.english: He has one hundred percent enthusiasm for this project and works until very late every day.

examples.english: You need to wait for the right moment before you can propose this plan.

examples.english: As a journalist, she needs to pay attention to the latest current affairs news every day.

examples.chinese: 这家店的东西质量好，价格也便宜，真是很实惠。

examples.english: The products at this store are good quality and the prices are cheap too—it's really a great deal.

examples.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng de shè jiē ér shàng, zǒujìnle le gǔlǎo de sìmiào.
examples.english: She ascended the steps lightly and entered the ancient temple.

examples.chinese: 这次的失败使得他更加努力地工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shībài shǐde tā gèngjiā nǔlì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: This failure rendered him working even harder.

examples.chinese: 这位教练给我们示范了正确的游泳姿势。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoliàn gěi wǒmen shìfàn le zhèngquè de yóuyǒng zīshì.
examples.english: This coach demonstrated the correct swimming posture for us.

examples.chinese: 这种新式的教学方法在学校里很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīnshì de jiàoxué fāngfǎ zài xuéxiào lǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: This new style of teaching method is very popular in schools.

examples.chinese: 这个公司在市场上的势力越来越强，已经成为行业的领导者。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī zài shìchǎng shang de shìli yuèláiyuè qiáng, yǐjīng chéngwéi hángyè de lǐngdǎo zhě.
examples.english: This company's strength in the market is growing stronger and stronger, and it has already become an industry leader.

examples.chinese: 他试图说服父母同意他出国留学的计划。
examples.pinyin: Tā shìtú shuōfú fùmǔ tóngyì tā chūguó liúxué de jìhuà.
examples.english: He attempted to persuade his parents to agree with his plan to study abroad.

examples.chinese: 这个视频的制作质量很高，我看了好几遍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shìpín de zhìzuò zhìliàng hěn gāo, wǒ kànle hǎo jǐ biàn.
examples.english: The production quality of this video is very high, and I've watched it several times.

examples.chinese: 这家大公司计划收购几家小型科技企业来扩展业务。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā dà gōngsī jìhuà shōugòu jǐ jiā xiǎoxíng kējì qǐyè lái kuòzhǎn yèwù.
examples.english: This large company plans to purchase several small tech companies to expand its business.

examples.chinese: 他花了两年时间收集了数千件古董。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle liǎng nián shíjiān shōují le shǔ qiān jiàn gǔdǒng.
examples.english: He spent two years collecting thousands of antiques.

examples.chinese: 妈妈让我在朋友来之前把房间收拾干净。
examples.pinyin: Māma ràng wǒ zài péngyou lái zhīqián bǎ fángjiān shōushi gān净.
examples.english: Mom asked me to tidy up my room before my friends arrive.

examples.chinese: 公司采取了多种手段来提高员工的工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī cǎiqǔle duō zhǒng shǒuduàn lái tígāo yuángōng de gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The company adopted various measures to improve employee work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 这家日本餐厅的寿司非常新鲜，我每个月都会来吃一次。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā Rìběn cāntīng de shòusī fēicháng xīnxiān, wǒ měi ge yuè dōu huì lái chī yī cì.
examples.english: The sushi at this Japanese restaurant is very fresh, and I come here to eat it once every month.

examples.chinese: 这个销售员用了很多巧妙的手法来说服顾客购买他的产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòuyuán yòngle hěnduō qiǎomiào de shǒufǎ lái shuōfú gùkè gòumǎi tā de chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This salesman used many clever maneuvers to persuade customers to buy his products.

examples.chinese: 今年洪水导致许多农村地区受灾，政府已经派出救援队前去帮助。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián hónghuǐ dǎozhì xǔduō nóngcūn dìqū shòu zāi, zhèngfǔ yǐjīng pāichūle jiùyuán duì qiánqu bāngzhù.
examples.english: This year's floods caused many rural areas to be disaster-stricken, and the government has already sent rescue teams to help.

examples.chinese: 许多人视为成功的标志就是拥有一套自己的房子。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén shìwéi chénggōng de biāozhì jiùshì yōngyǒu yī tào zìjǐ de fángzi.
examples.english: Many people regard owning their own house as a sign of success.

examples.chinese: 他最近工作太忙，吃饭不规律，瘦了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò tài máng, chīfàn bù guīlǜ, shòu le hěn duō.
examples.english: He's been working too hard recently, eating irregularly, and has become much skinnier.

examples.chinese: 他花了很多年的时间练习书法，现在已经成为了一位很有名的书法家。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle hěnduō nián de shíjiān liànxí shūfǎ, xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéile yī wèi hěn yǒumíng de shūfǎjiā.
examples.english: He spent many years practicing calligraphy and has now become a very famous calligrapher.

examples.chinese: 我的书桌上堆满了书和文件，需要好好整理一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shūzhuō shang duīmǎn le shū hé wénjiàn, xūyào hǎohāo zhěnglǐ yīxià.
examples.english: My desk is piled high with books and documents; I need to organize it properly.

examples.chinese: 这家公司每年输出大量的电子产品到海外市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī měi nián shūchū dàliàng de diànzǐ chǎnpǐn dào hǎiwài shìchǎng.
examples.english: This company exports a large quantity of electronic products to overseas markets every year.

examples.chinese: 我的书柜里放满了各种各样的书，从文学到历史都有。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shūguì lǐ fàngmǎn le gèzhǒng gèyàng de shū, cóng wénxué dào lìshǐ dōu yǒu.
examples.english: My bookcase is filled with all kinds of books, from literature to history.

examples.chinese: 老鼠在厨房里偷吃了我们的米粒。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshǔ zài chúfáng lǐ tōuchīle wǒmen de mǐlì.
examples.english: The rat stole and ate our rice grains in the kitchen.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的蔬菜都是从当地农场直接运来的，非常新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de shūcài dōu shì cóng dāngdì nóngchǎng zhíjiē yùn lái de, fēicháng xīnxiān.
examples.english: The vegetables at this restaurant are all delivered directly from local farms, so they're very fresh.

examples.chinese: 我的鼠标坏了，所以我用触控板来操作电脑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǔbiāo huài le, suǒyǐ wǒ yòng chùkòngbǎn lái cāozuò diànnǎo.
examples.english: My mouse broke, so I've been using the touchpad to operate the computer.

examples.chinese: 经过几年的工作，他已经对这个行业非常熟悉了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de gōngzuò, tā yǐjīng duì zhège hángyè fēicháng shúxī le.
examples.english: After several years of work, he has become very familiar with this industry.

examples.chinese: 他在比赛中不小心摔倒了，但是很快就站起来继续跑。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng búxiǎoxin shuāidǎo le, búshì hěnkuài jiù zhàn qǐlai jìxù pǎo.
examples.english: He accidentally fell down during the competition, but quickly got up and continued running.

examples.chinese: 他一不小心摔了一跤，手机也摔坏了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī búxiǎoxīn shuāi le yī jiāo, shǒujī yě shuāi huài le.
examples.english: He accidentally took a fall, and his phone got broken too.

examples.chinese: 今年参加比赛的学生数目比去年增加了很多。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián cānjiā bǐsài de xuésheng shùmù bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle hěnduō.
examples.english: The number of students participating in the competition this year has increased significantly compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 她双手捧着那本珍贵的古籍，生怕弄坏了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuāngshǒu pěngzhe nà běn zhēnguì de gǔjí, shēngpà nòng huài le.
examples.english: She held that precious ancient book with both hands, afraid of damaging it.

examples.chinese: 这家超市的水产品质量很好，价格也比较合理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shuǐchǎnpǐn zhìliàng hěn hǎo, jiàgé yě bǐjiào héalǐ.
examples.english: The water products at this supermarket are of good quality, and the prices are also quite reasonable.

examples.chinese: 这位将军率领着数千名士兵成功地攻占了敌方的堡垒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn shuàilǐng zhe shù qiān míng shìbīng chénggōng de gōngzhàn le díffāng de bǎolěi.
examples.english: This general led thousands of soldiers and successfully captured the enemy's fortress.

examples.chinese: 这种水果的水分很充足，吃起来特别甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ de shuǐfèn hěn ch充zú, chīqǐlai tèbié tián.
examples.english: This type of fruit has plenty of moisture content and tastes particularly sweet when eaten.

examples.chinese: 这个水库为附近的城市供应了大量的饮用水。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shuǐkù wèi fùjìn de chéngshì gōngyìngle dàliàng de yǐnyòngshuǐ.
examples.english: This reservoir supplies a large amount of drinking water to nearby cities.

examples.chinese: 去年夏天的水灾造成了很多人失去了家园。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián xiàtiān de shuǐzāi zàochéngle hěnduō rén shīqùle jiāyuán.
examples.english: The flood last summer caused many people to lose their homes.

examples.chinese: 关于这个问题，专家们有不同的说法，我们需要听听各方的意见。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, zhuānjiāmen yǒu bú同de shuōfa, wǒmen xūyào tīngtīng gèfāng de yìjiàn.
examples.english: Regarding this issue, experts have different ways of saying it, so we need to listen to opinions from all sides.

examples.chinese: 他去年获得了计算机硕士学位，现在在一家科技公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā qùnián huòdéle jìsuànjī shuòshì xuéwèi, xiànzài zài yī jiā kējì gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: He obtained his Master's degree in Computer Science last year and now works at a tech company.

examples.chinese: 这是我的私人电话号码，请不要告诉别人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de sīrén diànhuà hàomǎ, qǐngwù gàosu biérén.
examples.english: This is my private phone number, please don't tell anyone else.

examples.chinese: 长期睡眠不足会影响你的工作效率和身体健康。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī shuìmián búzú huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ de gōngzuò xiàoǜ hé shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Chronic sleep deprivation will affect your work efficiency and physical health.

examples.chinese: 警察搜查了嫌疑人的房间，但没有找到任何证据。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá sōuchá le xiányírén de fángjiān, dàn méiyǒu zhǎodào rènhé zhèngjù.
examples.english: The police searched the suspect's room, but found no evidence.

examples.chinese: 我们在山顶上，四周都是美丽的风景。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shāndǐng shang, sìzhōu dōu shì měilì de fēngjǐng.
examples.english: We are on top of the mountain, and beautiful scenery surrounds us on all sides.

examples.chinese: 警察搜索了那栋房子，希望能找到失踪的证据。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá sōusuǒle nà dòng fángzi, xīwàng néng zhǎodào shīzōng de zhèngjù.
examples.english: The police searched the building, hoping to find the missing evidence.

examples.chinese: 我们学校的宿舍条件不太好，但是同学们相处得很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de sùshè tiáojiàn búzhào hǎo, búshì tóngxuémen xiāngchǔ de hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: The dormitory conditions at our school aren't very good, but the students get along very well with each other.

examples.chinese: 人生就像品尝美食一样，要经历酸甜苦辣，才能真正懂得生活的意义。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng jiùxiàng pǐncháng měishí yīyàng, yào jīnglì suāntiánkǔlà, cái néng zhēnzhèng dǒnde shēnghuó de yìyì.
examples.english: Life is like tasting food; you must experience the ups and downs of life to truly understand the meaning of living.

examples.chinese: 在家里你可以随意穿着,不需要那么正式。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiālǐ nǐ kěyǐ suíyì chuānzháo, búxūyào nàme zhèngshì.
examples.english: At home you can dress casually as you please, there's no need to be so formal.

examples.chinese: 会议开始后，经理讲完了公司的新计划，随后员工们开始提出自己的意见。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì kāishǐ hòu, jīnglǐ jiǎngwán le gōngsī de xīn jìhuà, suíhòu yuángōngmen kāishǐ tíchūlái zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: After the meeting started, the manager finished explaining the company's new plan, and soon after, the employees began to share their opinions.

examples.chinese: 许多岁月过去了，我们依然记得那段美好的时光。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō suìyuè guòqù le, wǒmen yīrán jìde nà duàn měihǎo de shíguāng.
