examples.english: Many years have passed, and we still remember that beautiful period of time.

examples.chinese: 在解决这个问题时，我们需要换一种思维方式。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiějué zhège wèntí shí, wǒmen xūyào huàn yī zhǒng sīwéi fāngshì.
examples.english: When solving this problem, we need to change our way of thinking.

examples.chinese: 他不小心把杯子摔碎了，碎片散落了一地。
examples.pinyin: Tā búxiǎoxin bǎ bēizi shuāi suì le, suì piàn sǎnluò le yī dì.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped the cup and broke it into pieces, with fragments scattered all over the floor.

examples.chinese: 随着年龄的增长，我们对生活的理解也变得更深刻了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe niánlìng de zēngzhǎng, wǒmen duì shēnghuó de lǐjiě yě biàn de gèng shēnkè le.
examples.english: As we grow older, our understanding of life becomes deeper.

examples.chinese: 长期熬夜会损害你的身体健康。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī áoyè huì sǔnhài nǐ de shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Staying up late for a long time will damage your physical health.

examples.chinese: 我们公司所在的这个办公楼交通很便利。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī suǒzài de zhège bàngōngshì jiāotōng hěn biànyì.
examples.english: The office building where our company is located has very convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 你出门前别忘了锁上门，这个小区最近失窃案件比较多。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chūmén qián bié wàngle suǒ shàng mén, zhège xiǎoqū zuìjìn shīqiè ànjiàn比较 duō.
examples.english: Don't forget to lock the door before you go out. There have been quite a few theft cases in this residential community recently.

examples.chinese: 由于管理不善，公司今年遭受了巨大的经济损失。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú guǎnlǐ búshàn, gōngsī jīnnián zāoshòule jùdà de jīngjì sǔnshī.
examples.english: Due to poor management, the company suffered significant financial losses this year.

examples.chinese: 昨天的台风让整个城市停电了，很多人都被困在家里。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de táifēng ràng zhěngge chéngshì tíngdiàn le, hěnduō rén dōu bèi kùnzài jiāli.
examples.english: Yesterday's typhoon caused a power outage throughout the entire city, and many people were stuck at home.

examples.chinese: 听到有人叫他的名字，他抬头看了一眼，发现是一个久未见面的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào yǒu rén jiào tā de míngzi, tā táitóu kàn le yī yǎn, fāxiàn shì yī ge jiǔ wèi jiànmiàn de lǎo péngyou.
examples.english: Hearing someone call his name, he raised his head and glanced up, discovering it was an old friend he hadn't seen in a long time.

examples.chinese: 宇航员在太空中进行了许多重要的科学实验。
examples.pinyin: Yǔhángyuán zài tàikōng zhōng jìnxíngले le xǔduō zhònyào de kēxué shíyàn.
examples.english: The astronauts conducted many important scientific experiments in space.

examples.chinese: 他抬起头，看了看窗外的天空。
examples.pinyin: Tā táiqǐ tóu, kànle kan chuāngwài de tiānkōng.
examples.english: He lifted his head and looked at the sky outside the window.

examples.chinese: 她在音乐会上弹了一首很难的钢琴曲。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīnyuèhuì shang tánle yī shǒu hěn nán de gāngqin qū.
examples.english: She played a very difficult piano piece at the concert.

examples.chinese: 那个小偷看到警察来了，立刻逃跑了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu kàndào jǐngchá lái le, lìkè táopǎo le.
examples.english: When the thief saw the police coming, he immediately fled.

examples.chinese: 那个小偷看到警察来了，立刻逃走了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu kàndào jǐngchá lái le, lìkè táozǒu le.
examples.english: The thief ran away immediately when he saw the police coming.

examples.chinese: 那个逃犯已经被警察抓住了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge táofàn yǐjīng bèi jǐngchá zhuāzhù le.
examples.english: That fugitive has already been caught by the police.

examples.chinese: 今年的桃子特别甜，我买了好几斤送给了朋友。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de táozi tèbié tián, wǒ mǎile hǎo jǐ jīn sònggěile péngyou.
examples.english: This year's peaches are particularly sweet, so I bought several kilograms and gave them to my friends.

examples.chinese: 春天来了，院子里的桃树开满了粉红色的花。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, yuànzi lǐ de táoshù kāimǎn le fěnhóng sè de huā.
examples.english: Spring has arrived, and the peach tree in the yard is full of pink blossoms.

examples.chinese: 我很讨厌那些不守时的人，这样很不尊重别人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn tǎoyàn nàxiē bù shǒushí de rén, zhèyàng hěn búzūnjìng biérén.
examples.english: I really dislike people who are always late; it's very disrespectful to others.

examples.chinese: 春天到了，公园里的桃花开得特别灿烂，吸引了很多游客来拍照。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, gōngyuán lǐ de táohuā kāi de tèbié càànlan, xīyǐn le hěnduō yóukè lái pāizhào.
examples.english: Spring has arrived, and the peach flowers in the park are blooming especially beautifully, attracting many tourists to take photos.

examples.chinese: 每种材料都有自己独特的特性，这决定了它的用途。
examples.pinyin: Měi zhǒng cáiliào dōu yǒu zìjǐ dúté de tèxìng, zhè juédìngle tā de yòngtú.
examples.english: Every type of material has its own unique characteristics, which determine its uses.

examples.chinese: 中国茶文化有着几千年的历史，这是中国特有的传统。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó chá wénhuà yǒuzhe jǐ qiānniánde lìshǐ, zhè shì Zhōngguó tèyǒu de chuántǒng.
examples.english: Chinese tea culture has a history of thousands of years, which is a tradition characteristic of China.

examples.chinese: 这个项目只针对特定的用户群体开放。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zhǐ zh針duì tèdìng de yònghù qúntǐ kāifàng.
examples.english: This project is only open to a specific user group.

examples.chinese: 学校提倡学生多读书，这样可以开阔视野。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào tíchàng xuésheng duō dúshū, zhèyàng kěyǐ kāikuò shì野。
examples.english: The school advocates that students read more books, which can broaden their horizons.

examples.chinese: 一提起他的名字，她的脸色就变了。
examples.pinyin: Yī tíqǐ tā de míngzì, tā de liǎnsè jiù biàn le.
examples.english: As soon as his name is mentioned, her expression changes.

examples.chinese: 老师提示我们要提前准备期末考试。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíshì wǒmen yào tíqián zhǔnbèi qīmò kǎoshì.
examples.english: The teacher pointed out that we should prepare for the final exam in advance.

examples.chinese: 这个冰箱的体积太大了，放不进厨房里。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bīngxiāng de tǐjī tài dà le, fàng bu jìn chúfáng lǐ.
examples.english: This refrigerator's volume is too large and won't fit in the kitchen.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的题材很新颖，讲述了一个关于人工智能的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de tícái hěn xīnyǐng, jiǎngshù le yī gè guānyú réngōng zhìhuì de gùshì.
examples.english: The subject matter of this film is quite novel, telling a story about artificial intelligence.

examples.chinese: 虽然他是个天才，但他从不骄傲，还是很努力地工作。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā shì ge tiāncái, dàn tā cóngbù jiāo'ào, háishi hěn nǔlì de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Although he is a genius, he is never arrogant and still works very hard.

examples.chinese: 这个城市已经安装了天然气管道，很多家庭都开始使用天然气来做饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǐjīng ānzhuāngle tiānránqì guǎndào, hěnduō jiātíng dōu kāishǐ shǐyòng tiānránqì lái zuòfàn.
examples.english: This city has already installed natural gas pipelines, and many households have started using natural gas for cooking.

examples.chinese: 长时间的工作消耗了他很多体力，他感到非常疲劳。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān de gōngzuò xiāohàole tā hěnduō tǐlì, tā gǎndào fēicháng píláo.
examples.english: The long hours of work exhausted a lot of his physical strength, and he felt extremely tired.

examples.chinese: 他对天文学很感兴趣，经常在晚上用望远镜观察星星。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì tiānwénxué hěn gǎnxìngqù, jīngcháng zài wǎnshang yòng wàngyuǎnjìng guānchá xīngxing.
examples.english: He is very interested in astronomy and often observes stars with a telescope at night.

examples.chinese: 我父亲在政府部门的外交厅工作已经十年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn zài zhèngfǔ bùmén de wàijiāo tīng gōngzuò yǐjīng shí nián le.
examples.english: My father has been working in the Foreign Affairs Department of the government for ten years.

examples.chinese: 两个邻居因为噪音问题吵架了，最后还是请了社区主任来调解。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge lín jū yīnwèi zào yīn wèntí chǎojià le, zuìhòu háishi qǐngle shèhuì zhǔrèn lái tiáojiě.
examples.english: The two neighbors quarreled over a noise problem, and in the end they asked the community director to mediate.

examples.chinese: 这种支付方式在大多数商店都是通用的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhīfù fāngshì zài dàduōshù shāngdiàn dōu shì tōngyòng de.
examples.english: This payment method is commonly accepted in most stores.

examples.chinese: 他被指控偷了公司的机密文件。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi zhǐkòng tōu le gōngsī de jīmì wénjiàn.
examples.english: He was accused of stealing confidential files from the company.

examples.chinese: 天气太热了，我需要调节空调的温度。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ xūyào tiáojié kōngtiáo de wēndù.
examples.english: The weather is too hot, so I need to adjust the air conditioner's temperature.

english: stay for a time or at a place

examples.chinese: 我们在北京只能停留三天，因为还要去其他城市。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài běi jīng zhǐ néng tíngliú sān tiān, yīnwèi háiyào qù qítā chéngshì.
examples.english: We can only stay in Beijing for three days because we still need to go to other cities.

examples.chinese: 他偷偷地看了她一眼，生怕被别人发现。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōutōu de kànle tā yī yǎn, shēngpà bèi biérén fāxiàn.
examples.english: He glanced at her on the sly, afraid of being discovered by others.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的土豆烧得很好吃，我每次来都要点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de tǔdòu shāo de hěn hǎochī, wǒ měi cì lái dōu yào diǎn.
examples.english: The potatoes at this restaurant are delicious; I order them every time I come here.

examples.chinese: 经过几个月的努力，我们的研究终于取得了突破。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de nǔlì, wǒmen de yánjiū zh终于 qǔdé le túpò.
examples.english: After several months of effort, our research finally made a breakthrough.

examples.chinese: 他用词不当，吐露了自己真实的想法。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng cí búdàng, tǔlù le zìjǐ zhēnshí de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: He misspoke and revealed his true thoughts.

examples.chinese: 小兔子在草地上蹦蹦跳跳，看起来很开心。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo tùzi zài cǎodì shang bèngbeng tiàotiao, kàn qǐlai hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The little rabbit was hopping and jumping on the grass, looking very happy.

examples.chinese: 这次出国访问的团长是我们公司的副总经理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chūguó fǎngwèn de tuánzhǎng shì wǒmen gōngsī de fù zǒng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: The head of this delegation visiting abroad is the deputy general manager of our company.

examples.chinese: 政府决定推行新的教育改革政策。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng tuīxíng xīn de jiàoyù gǎigé zhèngcè.
examples.english: The government decided to carry out a new education reform policy.

examples.chinese: 他决定脱离那个公司，去追求自己真正想要的事业。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéhuà tuōlí nàge gōngsī, qù zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xiǎngyào de shìyè.
examples.english: He decided to leave that company to pursue the career he truly wanted.

examples.chinese: 他对外界的看法很狭隘，总是拒绝接受新的观念。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì wàijiè de kànfǎ hěn xiáiài, zǒngshì jùjué jiēshòu xīn de guānniàn.
examples.english: His views of the external world are very narrow, and he always refuses to accept new ideas.

examples.chinese: 这个项目完了，我们的努力都白费了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù wánliǎo, wǒmen de nǔlì dōu báifèi le.
examples.english: This project is done for; all our efforts were wasted.

examples.chinese: 我不想为难你，但这件事确实需要你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búxiǎng wéinán nǐ, dàn zhè jiàn shì quèshí xūyào nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: I don't want to put you in a difficult position, but this matter really needs your help.

examples.chinese: 她每天都在微博上分享自己的生活,已经有很多粉丝了。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu zài wēibó shang fēnxiǎng zìjǐ de shēnghuó, yǐjīng yǒu hěnduō fěnsī le.
examples.english: She shares her daily life on Weibo every day and already has many followers.

examples.chinese: 这次培训课程为期两周，每天都有不同的专家来授课。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì péixùn kèchéng wéiqī liǎng zhōu, měi tiān dōu yǒu búhuà de zhuānjiā lái shòukè.
examples.english: This training course lasts two weeks, with different experts teaching every day.

examples.chinese: 到目前为止，我们已经完成了项目的大部分工作。
examples.pinyin: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, wǒmen yǐjīng wánchéngle xiàngmù de dàbùfen gōngzuò.
examples.english: Until now, we have already completed most of the project's work.

examples.chinese: 公司偷税漏税的行为是违法的，最后被罚款了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī tōu shuì lòu shuì de xíngwéi shì wéifǎ de, zuìhòu bèi fákuǎn le.
examples.english: The company's tax evasion behavior was illegal, and they were eventually fined.

examples.chinese: 他因为违反了公司的规定而被开除了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi wéifǎnle gōngsī de guīdìng ér bèi kāichúle.
examples.english: He was fired because he violated the company's regulations.

examples.chinese: 这次会议主要围绕公司的发展战略展开讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì zhǔyào wéirào gōngsī de fāzhǎn zhànlüè zhǎnkāi tǎolùn.
examples.english: The main focus of this meeting revolved around the company's development strategy.

examples.chinese: 公司因为违规使用员工的个人信息而被罚款。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yīnwèi wéiguī shǐyòng yuángōng de gèrén xìnxī érbeì fákuǎn.
examples.english: The company was fined for violating regulations by misusing employees' personal information.

examples.chinese: 由于工作太忙，我委托了律师处理这件法律纠纷。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò tài máng, wǒ wěituōle lǜshī chǔlǐ zhè jiàn fǎlǜ ji纠fēn.
examples.english: Because I was too busy with work, I entrusted a lawyer to handle this legal dispute.

examples.chinese: 这是我唯一能帮助你的方法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ wéiyī néng bāngzhù nǐ de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: This is the only way I can help you.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜肴以川菜为主，也有一些粤菜选择。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de càiyao yǐ chuānCAI wéizhǔ, yě yǒu yīxiē yuècài xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are mainly Sichuan cuisine, with some Cantonese options as well.

examples.chinese: 这颗卫星可以帮助我们预测天气和监测环境变化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē wèixīng kěyǐ bāngzhù wǒmen yùcè tiānqì hé jiānncè huanjìng biànhuà.
examples.english: This satellite can help us forecast weather and monitor environmental changes.

examples.chinese: 这位老师的温和态度让学生们都很喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī de wēnhé tàidù ràng xuéshengmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: This teacher's mild attitude makes all the students like him very much.

examples.chinese: 我吃了太多辛辣的食物，现在胃很不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chīle tàiduō xīnlà de shíwù, xiànzài wèi hěn búshūfu.
examples.english: I ate too much spicy food, and now my stomach feels very uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 听说你生病了，我们公司的经理专门来慰问你。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ shēngbìng le, wǒmen gōngsī de jīnglǐ zhuānmén lái wèiwèn nǐ.
examples.english: Hearing that you were sick, our company manager came specifically to express sympathy to you.

examples.chinese: 他紧紧握住我的手，不想让我离开。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn wòzhù wǒ de shǒu, búxiǎng ràng wǒ líkāi.
examples.english: He held my hand tightly, not wanting to let me leave.

examples.chinese: 她喜欢看一些文艺电影，觉得比商业大片更有意思。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān kàn yīxiē wényì diànyǐng, juéde bǐ shāngyè dàpiàn gèng yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: She likes to watch some artistic films because she thinks they are more interesting than commercial blockbusters.

examples.chinese: 工厂排放的污水污染了附近的河流，引起了当地居民的强烈反对。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pāifàng de wūshuǐ wūrǎnle fùjìn de héliú, yǐnqǐle le dāngdì jūmín de qiángliè fǎnduì.
examples.english: The slops discharged by the factory polluted the nearby river, causing strong opposition from local residents.

examples.chinese: 我的卧室虽然不大，但是布置得很舒适。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de wòshì suīrán búdà, búshì búzhì de hěn shūshì.
examples.english: Although my bedroom is not large, it is decorated very comfortably.

examples.chinese: 他无奈地叹了口气，因为他的计划又被改变了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wúnài de tànle kǒu qì, yīnwèi tā de jìhuà yòu bèi gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: He sighed helplessly because his plan had been changed again.

examples.chinese: 工厂排放的废气严重污染了我们城市的空气质量。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pāifàng de fèiqì yánzhòng wūrǎn le wǒmen chéngshì de kōngqì zhìliàng.
examples.english: The exhaust gas discharged by factories has seriously polluted the air quality of our city.

examples.chinese: 她在舞台上的舞蹈表演赢得了全场观众的掌声。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǔtái shang de wǔdǎo biǎoyǎn yíngdéle quánchǎng guāny众de zhǎngsheng.
examples.english: Her dance performance on stage won applause from the entire audience.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的成功无疑得益于演员们的精彩表演。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de chénggōng wúyí déyì yú yǎnyuànyuánmen de jīngcǎi biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: The success of this film is undoubtedly due to the actors' excellent performances.

examples.chinese: 最近物价上升了，我们的生活成本也跟着增加了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wùjià shànngshēng le, wǒmen de shēnghuó chéngběn yě gēnzhe zēngjiā le.
examples.english: Recently, commodity prices have risen, and our cost of living has increased accordingly.

examples.chinese: 这间屋子虽然很小，但是收拾得很干净，让人感到很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān wūzi suīrán hěn xiǎo, dànshì shōushi de hěn gānnjìng, ràng rén gǎndào hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Although this house is small, it is kept very clean, which makes people feel very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 我们小区的物业服务质量不太好，经常有住户投诉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎoqū de wùyè fúwù zhìliàng búhuò hǎo, jīngcháng yǒu zhùhù tóusu.
examples.english: The property management service quality in our residential community is not very good, and residents often file complaints.

examples.chinese: 这个社会过于追求物质财富，反而忽视了精神生活的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèhuì guòyú zhuīqiú wùzhì cáifù, fǎn'ér húshìle jīngshén shēnghuó de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: This society pursues material wealth too much, but in turn neglects the importance of spiritual life.

examples.chinese: 他误解了我的意思，以为我不想帮他。
examples.pinyin: Tā wùjiě le wǒ de yìsi, yǐwéi wǒ búxiǎng bāng tā.
examples.english: He misunderstood what I meant and thought I didn't want to help him.

examples.chinese: 这道西红柿汤的味道真不错，我妈妈经常这样做。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào xīhóngshì tāng de wèidào zhēn búcuò, wǒ māma jīngcháng zhèyàng zuò.
examples.english: This tomato soup tastes really good; my mom makes it like this all the time.

examples.chinese: 这部喜剧让我笑得很开心，我推荐你去看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xǐjù ràng wǒ xiào de hěn kāixīn, wǒ tuījiàn nǐ qù kàn.
examples.english: This comedy made me laugh happily, I recommend you go watch it.

examples.chinese: 明天的重要会议上，我需要穿上西装来给客户留下好印象。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhòngyào huìyì shang, wǒ xūyào chuānshang xīzhuāng lái gěi kèhù liúxia hǎo yìnxiàng.
examples.english: I need to wear a suit to the important meeting tomorrow to make a good impression on the clients.

examples.chinese: 他最喜欢看京剧，每个月都会去剧院看一两场戏。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì xǐhuān kàn jīngjù, měi ge yuè dōu huì qù jùyuàn kàn yī liǎng chǎng xì.
examples.english: He loves watching Peking opera the most and goes to the theater to see one or two performances every month.

examples.chinese: 这部戏剧在国际舞台上获得了很多奖项。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xìjù zài guójì wǔtái shang huòdé le hěnduō jiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: This dramatic work won many awards on the international stage.

examples.chinese: 我被突然的声音吓了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bèi túrán de shēngyīn xiàle yī tiào.
examples.english: I was startled by the sudden sound.

examples.chinese: 我先前没有告诉你是因为不想让你担心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiānqián méiyǒu gàosu nǐ shì yīnwèi búxiǎng ràng nǐ dānxin.
examples.english: I didn't tell you before because I didn't want you to worry.

examples.chinese: 这件红色的衣服颜色很鲜艳，特别适合年轻人穿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn hóng sè de yīfu yánsè hěn xiānyàn, tèbié shìhé niánqīngrén chuān.
examples.english: This red dress has a bright color that is especially suitable for young people to wear.

examples.chinese: 这次比赛中，他的实力显得特别突出。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài zhōng, tā de shílì xiǎnde tèbié突出。
examples.english: In this competition, his ability was particularly outstanding.

examples.chinese: 这三个项目先后完成了，为公司带来了很大的收益。
examples.pinyin: Zhè sān ge xiàngmù xiānhòu wánchéngle, wéi gōngsī dàilái le hěn dà de shōuyì.
examples.english: These three projects were completed one after another, bringing significant profits to the company.

examples.chinese: 我们现有的资源还不足以完成这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànyǒu de zīyuán háishi búzú yǐ wánchéng zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: The resources we currently have are still insufficient to complete this project.

examples.chinese: 我们需要了解市场的现状，才能制定更好的发展策略。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào liǎojiě shìchǎng de xiànzhuàng, cáinéng zhìdìng gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn cèlüè.
examples.english: We need to understand the current state of the market in order to develop a better development strategy.

examples.chinese: 他为了慈善事业献出了自己的一生。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile císhàn shìyè xiànchūle zìjǐ de yībēi.
examples.english: He dedicated his entire life to charitable causes.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢在闲暇时间读书和散步。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān zài xiánxiá shíjiān dúshū hé sǎnbù.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to read and take walks in my leisure time.

examples.chinese: 警察根据目击者提供的线索，很快就找到了嫌疑人。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá gēnjù mùjī zhě tígōng de xiànsuǒ, hěnkuài jiù zhǎodào le xiányí rén.
examples.english: Based on the clues provided by the witness, the police quickly found the suspect.

examples.chinese: 随着城市发展，越来越多的年轻人离开乡村到大城市去工作。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén líkāi xiāngcūn dào dà chéngshì qù gōngzuò.
examples.english: As cities develop, more and more young people leave the countryside to work in big cities.

examples.chinese: 这两个三角形的面积相等，但形状不同。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge sānjiǎoxíng de miànjī xiāngděng, dàn xíngzhuàng búyòng.
examples.english: These two triangles have equal areas, but different shapes.

examples.chinese: 早餐我通常吃面包和香肠，这是我最喜欢的搭配。
examples.pinyin: Zǎocān wǒ tōngcháng chī miànbāo hé xiāngcháng, zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de dāpèi.
examples.english: For breakfast, I usually eat bread and sausage, which is my favorite combination.

examples.chinese: 医生详细地向患者解释了手术的风险和益处。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng xiángxì de xiàng huànzhě jiěshìle shǒushù de fēngxiǎn hé yìchu处。
examples.english: The doctor explained the risks and benefits of the surgery to the patient in detail.

examples.chinese: 随着公司的发展，我们需要相应地增加员工的数量。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gōngsī de fāzhǎn, wǒmen xūyào xiāngying de zēngjiā yuángōng de shùliàng.
examples.english: As the company develops, we need to correspondingly increase the number of employees.

examples.chinese: 他离开乡下已经十年了，这次回乡见到了很多童年的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā líkāi xiāngxià yǐjīng shí nián le, zhè cì huí xiāng jiàndàole hěnduō tóngniánde péngyou.
examples.english: He left his hometown ten years ago, and this time returning to his village he saw many childhood friends.

examples.chinese: 登山时，我们请了一位经验丰富的向导来带领我们上山。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshān shí, wǒmen qǐngle yī wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de xiàngdǎo lái dàilǐng wǒmen shàngshān.
examples.english: When hiking, we hired an experienced guide to lead us up the mountain.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢在咖啡馆里享受安静的时光，读读书或者发呆。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān zài kāfēiguǎn lǐ xiǎngshòu ānjìng de shíguāng, dúdu shū huòzhě fāyā.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to enjoy quiet time at a café, reading books or just daydreaming.

examples.chinese: 他鼓励我们要向上发展，不能放弃自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Tā gǔlì wǒmen yào xiàngshàng fāzhǎn, búnéng fàngqì zìjǐ de梦想。
examples.english: He encouraged us to develop upward and not give up on our dreams.

examples.chinese: 这枚戒指象征着我们的爱情和承诺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè méi戒指 xiàngzh征 zhe wǒmen de àiqing hé chénggnuò.
examples.english: This ring symbolizes our love and commitment.

examples.chinese: 这个相声演员的笑话总是能逗得观众哈哈大笑。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngsheng yǎnyuán de xiàohuà zǒngshì néng dòu de guānzhòng hāhā dàxiào.
examples.english: This comic dialog performer's jokes always manage to make the audience laugh heartily.

examples.chinese: 医生用酒精消毒了伤口，然后才给我包扎。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng jiǔjīng xiāodú le shāngkǒu, ránhòu cái gěi wǒ bāozā.
examples.english: The doctor disinfected the wound with alcohol before bandaging it for me.

examples.chinese: 这次谈话消除了我们之间的误会。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánhuà xiāochúle wǒmen zhījiān de wùhuì.
examples.english: This conversation eliminated the misunderstanding between us.

examples.chinese: 尽管困难很多，我们还是要勇敢地向前走。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn kùnnan hěn duō, wǒmen háishi yào yǒngǎn de xiàngqián zǒu.
examples.english: Despite the many difficulties, we still need to move forward courageously.

examples.chinese: 昨天小区发生火灾，消防队员很快就赶到了现场。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xiǎoqū fāshēng huǒzāi, xiāofáng duìyuán hěnkuài jiù gǎndào le xiànchǎng.
examples.english: A fire broke out in the residential community yesterday, and the firefighters arrived at the scene quickly.

examples.chinese: 现在的消费者越来越关注产品的质量和环保性。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de xiāofèizhě yuèláiyuè guānzhù chǎnpǐn de zhìliàng hé huánbǎo xìng.
examples.english: Nowadays, consumers are paying more and more attention to product quality and environmental friendliness.

examples.chinese: 警察在街上抓住了一个小偷儿，他偷了好几家商店的东西。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài jiēshang zhuāzhù le yī ge xiǎotōur, tā tōu le hǎo jǐ jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi.
examples.english: The police caught a thief on the street who had stolen goods from several shops.

examples.chinese: 他对这个项目的态度太消极了，总是找各种借口不去参加会议。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhège xiàngmù de tàidù tài xiāojí le, zǒngshì zhǎo gèzhǒng jièkǒu búqù参加 huìyì.
examples.english: His attitude toward this project is too negative; he always finds various excuses not to attend the meetings.

examples.chinese: 工作了一整天，我们决定在咖啡馆里歇一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò le yī zhěngtiān, wǒmen jué定 zài kāfēiguǎn lǐ xiē yīhuǐr.
examples.english: After working all day, we decided to rest for a while at the coffee shop.

examples.chinese: 双方已经签署了合作协议书，接下来就要按照协议的条款执行了。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yǐjīng qiānshǔle hézuò xiéyìshū, jiēxiàlái jiùyào ànzhào xiéyì de tiáokuǎn zhíxíng le.
examples.english: Both parties have signed the cooperation contract, and now they need to implement it according to the terms of the agreement.

examples.chinese: 阳光透过窗户斜射进房间，照亮了整个客厅。
examples.pinyin: Yángguāng透guò chuānghu斜shè jìn fángjiān, zhàoliàng le zhěngge kètīng.
examples.english: Sunlight shone obliquely through the window into the room, illuminating the entire living room.

examples.chinese: 要想成功，最重要的是调整好自己的心态。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chénggōng, zuì zhòngyào de shì tiáozhěng hǎo zìjǐ de xīntài.
examples.english: If you want to succeed, the most important thing is to adjust your state of mind.

examples.chinese: 看到孩子生病了，妈妈特别心疼，整夜都没睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào háizi shēngbìng le, māma tèbié xīnténg, zhěngyè dōu méi shuìjiào.
examples.english: Seeing that her child was sick, the mother felt deeply distressed and didn't sleep the whole night.

examples.chinese: 你这些年辛苦工作，终于换来了成功。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèxiē nián xīnkǔ gōngzuò, zh終于 huàn lái le chénggōng.
examples.english: After years of hard work, you have finally achieved success.

examples.chinese: 双方签署了一份新的贸易协议，这将大大促进两国之间的经济合作。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng qiānshǔ le yī fèn xīn de màoyì xiéyì, zhè jiāng dàdà cùjìn liǎng guó zhījiān de jīngjì hézuò.
examples.english: Both parties signed a new trade agreement, which will greatly promote economic cooperation between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 我很欣赏你的勇气和坚持，这些品质值得学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīnshǎng nǐ de yǒngqì hé jiānchí, zhèxiē pǐnzhì zhídé xuéxí.
examples.english: I really appreciate your courage and perseverance; these qualities are worth learning from.

examples.chinese: 我每天都会检查办公室的信箱，看看有没有重要的来信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu huì jiǎnchá bàngōngshì de xìnxiāng, kànkan yǒu méiyǒu zhòngyào de láixìn.
examples.english: I check the office mailbox every day to see if there are any important letters.

examples.chinese: 这辆公交车在城市街道上行驶了很多年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng gōngjiāo chē zài chéngshì jiēdào shàng xíngshǐ le hěnduō nián.
examples.english: This bus has been operating on city streets for many years.

examples.chinese: 他坚定的信念帮助他度过了最困难的时期。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāndìng de xìnniàn bāngzhù tā dùguò le zuì kùnnan de shíqī.
examples.english: His firm belief helped him get through the most difficult period.

examples.chinese: 随着时代的发展，社会的形态也在不断地改变。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shídài de fāzhǎn, shèhuì de xíngtài yě zài búduàn de gǎibiàn.
examples.english: As time progresses, the configuration of society is also constantly changing.

examples.chinese: 这款新手机的性能比上一代提高了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn shǒujī de xìngnéng bǐ shàngyī dài tíngāo le hěnduō.
examples.english: This new phone's performance has improved a lot compared to the previous generation.

examples.chinese: 长城的雄伟气势让每个游客都感到震撼。
examples.pinyin: Chángchéng de xióngwěi qìshì ràng měi ge yóukè dōu gǎndào zhènhàn.
examples.english: The grand and majestic appearance of the Great Wall amazes every visitor.

examples.chinese: 这只熊在森林里冬眠了整个冬天。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xióng zài sēnlín lǐ dōngmián le zhěngge dōngtiān.
examples.english: This bear hibernated in the forest for the entire winter.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢穿着休闲的衣服，在咖啡馆里看书。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān chuānzháo xiūxián de yīfu, zài kāfēiguǎn lǐ kànshū.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to wear casual clothes and read books in a café.

examples.chinese: 这座古老的寺庙花了三年时间才修复完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de sìmiào huāle sān nián shíjiān cái xiūfù wánchéng.
examples.english: It took three years to restore this ancient temple.

examples.chinese: 一个有修养的人即使在困难的时候也不会对别人无礼。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge yǒu xiūyǎng de rén jíshǐ zài kùnnan de shíhou yě búhuì duì biérén wúlǐ.
examples.english: A person with good accomplishment will not be rude to others even in difficult times.

examples.chinese: 政府计划在这个地区修建一条新的高速公路。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà zài zhège dìqū xiūjiàn yī tiáo xīn de gāosù gōnglù.
examples.english: The government plans to build a new highway in this area.

examples.chinese: 他虽然很有才华，但始终保持虚心的态度，经常向别人请教。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán hěn yǒu cáihuà, dàn shǐzh终 bǎochí xūxīn de tàidù, jīngcháng xiàng biérén qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Although he is very talented, he always maintains a modest attitude and often asks others for advice.

examples.chinese: 我这学期选修了两门选修课，其中包括摄影和中国文化。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè xuéqī xuǎnxiū le liǎng mén xuǎnxiūkè, qīzhōng bāokuò shèyǐng hé Zhōngguó wénhuà.
examples.english: This semester I studied two elective courses, which include photography and Chinese culture.

examples.chinese: 我们学校今年新增了三个学科，包括人工智能、编程和数据分析。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào jīnnián xīnzēngle sān ge xuékē, bāokuò réngōng zhìnéng, biānchéng hé shùjù fēnxī.
examples.english: Our school added three new subjects this year, including artificial intelligence, programming, and data analysis.

examples.chinese: 她在大学里获得了硕士学位，现在在一家科技公司工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué lǐ huòdéle shuòshì xuéwèi, xiànzài zài yī jiā kējì gōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: She obtained a master's degree from university and now works at a tech company.

examples.chinese: 公司正在寻求新的商业机会来扩展市场。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài xúnqiú xīn de shāngyè jīhuì lái kuòzhǎn shìchǎng.
examples.english: The company is seeking new business opportunities to expand its market.

examples.chinese: 这位著名的历史学者在大学里教了三十年书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng de lìshǐ xuézhě zài dàxué lǐ jiāo le sānshí nián shū.
examples.english: This renowned history scholar has been teaching at the university for thirty years.

examples.chinese: 这个项目需要获得政府的许可才能开始施工。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào huòdé zhèngfǔ de xǔkě cái néng kāishǐ shīgōng.
examples.english: This project needs to obtain government permission before construction can begin.

examples.chinese: 租房子的时候，房东要求我付两个月的押金。
examples.pinyin: Zū fángzi de shíhou, fángdōng yāoqiú wǒ fù liǎng ge yuè de yājīn.
examples.english: When renting an apartment, the landlord required me to pay two months' deposit.

examples.chinese: 我打电话询问了公司关于这个项目的最新进展。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà xúnwèn le gōngsī guānyú zhège xiàngmù de zuìxīn jìnzhǎn.
examples.english: I called the company to ask about the latest progress of this project.

examples.chinese: 这条高速公路延伸到了山区，给当地人民带来了很多便利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gāosù gōnglù yánshēn dàole shānqū, gěi dāngdì rénmín dàilaile hěnduō biànlì.
examples.english: This expressway extends into the mountainous area, bringing a lot of convenience to the local people.

examples.chinese: 虽然他只获得了亚军，但他的表现已经让教练很满意了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐ huòdéle yàjūn, dàn tā de biǎoxiàn yǐjīng ràng jiàoliàn hěn mǎnyì le.
examples.english: Although he only won second place, his performance has already satisfied the coach.

examples.chinese: 湖边有很多鸭子在水里游泳，孩子们喜欢在那里喂它们。
examples.pinyin: Húbiān yǒu hěnduō yāzi zài shuǐ lǐ yóuyǒng, háizimen xǐhuān zài nàlǐ wèi tāmen.
examples.english: There are many ducks swimming in the water by the lake, and children like to feed them there.

examples.chinese: 老师对学生的迟到行为采取了严厉的态度。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì xuésheng de chídào xíngwéi cǎiqǔle yánlì de tàidù.
examples.english: The teacher took a stern attitude toward the students' lateness.

examples.chinese: 他用严肃的语气告诉我，这个项目必须在下周完成。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng yánsù de yǔqì gàosu wǒ, zhège xiàngmù bìxū zài xiàzhoū wánchéng.
examples.english: He told me in a serious tone that this project must be completed by next week.

examples.chinese: 他的言语中充满了对这个项目的热情。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yányu zhōng chōngmǎn le duì zhège xiàngmù de règíng.
examples.english: His spoken language was full of enthusiasm for this project.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥在中科院的研究所工作，他们正在做一个很有意思的项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge zài Zhōngkēyuàn de yánjiūsuǒ gōngzuò, tāmen zhèngzài zuò yīge hěn yǒu yìsi de xiàngmù.
examples.english: My older brother works at a research institute under the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and they are currently working on a very interesting project.

examples.chinese: 公司邀请了几位知名专家来分享他们的经验。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqǐngle jǐ wèi zhīmíng zhuānjiā lái fēnxiǎng tāmen de jīngyàn.
examples.english: The company invited several well-known experts to share their experience.

examples.chinese: 他有独特的眼光，总能发现别人忽视的商机。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu dúchuté de yǎnguāng, zǒng néng fāxiàn biérén húshì de shāngjī.
examples.english: He has a unique vision and can always discover business opportunities that others overlook.

examples.chinese: 当我告诉他这个计划太危险时，他只是摇头，什么话都没说。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ gàosu tā zhège jìhuà tài wēixiǎn shí, tā zhǐshì yáotóu, shénme huà dōu méi shuō.
examples.english: When I told him that the plan was too dangerous, he simply shook his head without saying anything.

examples.chinese: 你想去公园也好，想在家休息也好，我都可以陪你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù gōngyuán yěhǎo, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi yěhǎo, wǒ dōu kěyǐ péi nǐ.
examples.english: Whether you want to go to the park or rest at home, I can keep you company either way.

examples.chinese: 他在法庭上咬了同伙，导致整个犯罪团伙都被逮捕了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fǎtíng shang yǎole tónghuǒ, dǎozhì zhěnggè fànzuì tuánhuǒ dōu bèi逮pǔ le.
examples.english: He incriminated his accomplice in court, which resulted in the entire criminal gang being arrested.

examples.chinese: 我们公司的业务主要涉及软件开发和技术咨询。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de yèwù zhǔyào sh涉jí ruǎnjiàn kāifā hé jìshù zīxún.
examples.english: Our company's main business involves software development and technical consulting.

examples.chinese: 夜间工作的人需要保持精力充沛，这对他们的健康很有挑战。
examples.pinyin: Yèjiān gōngzuò de rén xūyào bǎochí jīnglì chōngpeì, zhè duì tāmen de jiànkāng hěn yǒu tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: People who work at night need to stay energetic, which is quite challenging for their health.

examples.chinese: 公司必须依法纳税，否则会面临罚款。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bìxū yīfǎ納shuì, fǒuzé huì miànlín fákuǎn.
examples.english: Companies must pay taxes in conformity with legal provisions, otherwise they will face fines.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的厨师是一流的，每道菜都做得非常精致。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de chúshī shì yīliú de, měi dào cài dōu zuò de fēicháng jīngzhì.
examples.english: The chef at this restaurant is top quality; every dish is made with great refinement.

examples.chinese: 根据市场调查的数据，公司依据消费者的需求开发了新产品。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shìchǎng diàochá de shùjù, gōngsī yījù xiāofèizhě de xūqiú kāifāle xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Based on market research data, the company developed new products according to consumer demands.

examples.chinese: 虽然已经是冬天了，他依旧坚持每天早上跑步。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán yǐjīng shì dōngtiān le, tā yījiù jiānchí měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.
examples.english: Even though it's already winter, he still insists on running every morning as usual.

examples.chinese: 我想和你一辈子在一起。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yībèizi zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: I want to be with you for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 这一带的餐厅都很不错，我经常在这里吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yīdài de cānguǎn dōu hěn búcuò, wǒ jīngcháng zài zhèlǐ chīfàn.
examples.english: The restaurants in this neighborhood are all quite good; I often eat here.

examples.chinese: 依照公司的规定，员工必须在下午五点之前完成工作报告。
examples.pinyin: Yīzhào gōngsī de guīdìng, yuángōng bìxū zài xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn zhīqián wánchéng gōngzuò bàogào.
examples.english: According to the company's regulations, employees must complete their work reports before 5 PM.

examples.chinese: 一旦你决定了目标，就要坚持不懈地努力。
examples.pinyin: Yīdàn nǐ juédìng le mùbiāo, jiù yào jiānchí búxié de nǔlì.
examples.english: Once you have decided on a goal, you must work at it persistently without giving up.

examples.chinese: 一句话，这个项目的成功取决于团队的合作。
examples.pinyin: Yījùhuà, zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng qǔjuéyú tuánduì de hézuò.
examples.english: In a word, the success of this project depends on the team's cooperation.

english: (used after a verb) give it a go

examples.chinese: 你先试一下儿这个新软件，看看好不好用。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān shì yīxiàr zhège xīn ruǎnjiàn, kànkan hǎo bu hǎoyòng.
examples.english: Why don't you try out this new software first and see if it works well.

examples.chinese: 他一下子就明白了我的意思。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīxiàzi jiù míngbai le wǒ de yìsi.
examples.english: He understood my meaning right away.

examples.chinese: 我们一路聊天，不知不觉就到了目的地。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīlù liáotiān, búzhī bújiào jiù dàole múdìdì.
examples.english: We chatted the whole way, and before we knew it, we had arrived at our destination.

examples.chinese: 他一向很守时，从来没有迟到过。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīxiàng hěn shǒushí, cónglái méiyǒu chídào guò.
examples.english: He has always been punctual and has never been late.

examples.chinese: 这个项目分为甲、乙两个阶段，我们现在正在处理乙阶段的工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù fēnwéi jiǎ、yǐ liǎng ge jiēduàn, wǒmen xiànzài zhèngzài chǔlǐ yǐ jiēduàn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: This project is divided into phase A and phase B. We are currently handling the work of phase B.

examples.chinese: 我们早点出发，以便赶上下午的会议。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǎodiǎn chūfā, yǐbiàn gǎnshang xiàwǔ de huìyì.
examples.english: We're leaving early so that we can make it to the afternoon meeting.

examples.chinese: 以往我们每个月都会一起出去旅游，但最近因为工作太忙，已经有半年没有见面了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐwǎng wǒmen měi ge yuè dōu huì yìqǐ chūqù lǚyóu, dàn zuìjìn yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng, yǐjīng yǒu bàn nián méiyǒu jiànmiàn le.
examples.english: In the past, we would travel together every month, but recently because of work being so busy, we haven't seen each other for half a year.

examples.chinese: 他一口气看完了整部电影，一点都没有休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīkǒuqì kànwán le zhěngbù diànyǐng, yīdiǎn dōu méiyǒu xiūxi.
examples.english: He watched the entire movie without a break and didn't rest at all.

examples.chinese: 他走进办公室的时候一身都是雨水，看起来很狼狈。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒujìn bàngōngshì de shíhou yīshēn dōushi shǔishuǐ, kànqǐlái hěn láng狈.
examples.english: When he walked into the office, his whole body was soaked with rainwater, and he looked quite disheveled.

examples.chinese: 我逐渐意识到这个决定可能会改变我的人生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhújiàn yìshi dào zhège juédìng kěnéng huì gǎibiàn wǒ de rénshēng.
examples.english: I gradually became conscious that this decision might change my life.

examples.chinese: 失业意味着他需要尽快找到新的工作。
examples.pinyin: Shīyè yìwèizhe tā xūyào jìnkuài zhǎodào xīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Losing his job means he needs to find a new one as soon as possible.

examples.chinese: 他凭着坚强的意志克服了许多困难。
examples.pinyin: Tā píngzhe jiānqiáng de yìzhì kèfúle xǔduō kùnnan.
examples.english: He overcame many difficulties through his strong willpower.

examples.chinese: 他因为工作太忙而没有时间陪家人，因而感到很内疚。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ér méiyǒu shíjiān péi jiārén, yīnér gǎndào hěn nèijiù.
examples.english: Because he was too busy with work to spend time with his family, consequently he felt very guilty.

examples.chinese: 这家咖啡馆的饮料种类很多，我每次都不知道该选哪一种。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn de yǐnliào zhǒnglèi hěn duō, wǒ měi cì dōu búzhīdào gāi xuǎn nǎ yī zhǒng.
examples.english: This café has many types of beverages, and I never know which one to choose each time.

examples.chinese: 这家公司专门从事书籍和杂志的印刷业务。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhuānmén cóngshì shūjí hé zázhì de yìnshuā yèwù.
examples.english: This company specializes in printing books and magazines.

examples.chinese: 健康的饮食习惯对身体发育非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng de yǐnshí xíguàn duì shēntǐ fāy育fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Healthy dietary habits are very important for physical development.

examples.chinese: 这张床垫太硬了，我睡得很不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng chuángdiàn tài yìng le, wǒ shuì de hěn búshūfu.
examples.english: This mattress is too hard, and I didn't sleep comfortably.

examples.chinese: 这台电脑的硬件配置太旧了，我们需要升级一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo de yìngjiàn pèizhì tài jiù le, wǒmen xūyào shēngjí yīxià.
examples.english: This computer's hardware configuration is too old; we need to upgrade it.

examples.chinese: 看到失散多年的家人，她激动得流泪，紧紧拥抱着他们。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào shīsǎn duō nián de jiārén, tā jīdòng de liúyè, jǐnjǐn yōngbào zhe tāmen.
examples.english: Upon seeing her family members whom she had been separated from for many years, she was so moved that she cried and embraced them tightly.

examples.chinese: 这家公司拥有最先进的技术和最优秀的团队。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu zuì xiānnjìn de jìshù hé zuì yōuxiù de tuánduì.
examples.english: This company possesses the most advanced technology and the most excellent team.

examples.chinese: 这个问题很简单，用不着请教专家。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn jiǎndān, yòngbuzháo qǐngjiào zhuānjiā.
examples.english: This problem is very simple; there's no need to consult an expert.

examples.chinese: 这个应用程序有很多用户，因为它非常好用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng chéngxù yǒu hěnduō yònghù, yīnwèi tā fēicháng hǎoyòng.
examples.english: This application has many users because it is very easy to use.

examples.chinese: 你应该早点告诉我这个重要的消息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi zǎodiǎn gàosu wǒ zhège zhònyào de xiāoxi.
examples.english: You should have told me this important news earlier.

examples.chinese: 这个应用程序是用来帮助学生管理他们的日程安排的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng chéngxù shì yònglái bāngzhù xuésheng guǎnlǐ tāmen de rìchéng ānpái de.
examples.english: This application is used to help students manage their schedules.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅经常给老顾客优惠，所以我很喜欢在这里吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng jīngcháng gěi lǎo gùkè yōuhuì, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn xǐhuān zài zhèlǐ chīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant often gives special treatment to regular customers, so I really like eating here.

examples.chinese: 在公司的发展中，我们优先考虑员工的安全和福利。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngsī de fāzhǎn zhōng, wǒmen yōuxiān kǎolǜ yuángōng de ānquán hé fúlì.
examples.english: In the company's development, we prioritize employee safety and welfare.

examples.chinese: 这个应用程序主要用于帮助学生管理他们的日常任务。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yìngyòng chéngxù zhǔyào yòngyú bāngzhù xuésheng guǎnlǐ tāmen de rìcháng rènwu.
examples.english: This application is mainly used to help students manage their daily tasks.

examples.chinese: 他讲话很幽默,总是能让我们在会议上笑起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎnghuà hěn yōumò, zǒngshì néng ràng wǒmen zài huìyì shàng xiào qǐlai.
examples.english: He speaks with great humor and always makes us laugh during meetings.

examples.chinese: 他的计划失败了，由此引发了公司内部的一系列问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shībài le, yóucǐ yǐnfā le gōngsī nèibù de yīxìliè wèntí.
examples.english: His plan failed, and as a result, it triggered a series of problems within the company.

examples.chinese: 这个城市很美，尤其是在春天的时候，樱花开满了整条街道。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì hěn měi, yóuqí shì zài chūntiān de shíhou, yīnghuā kāi mǎn le zhěng tiáo jiēdào.
examples.english: This city is very beautiful, especially in spring when cherry blossoms bloom all along the streets.

examples.chinese: 他在决定是否辞职的问题上犹豫了很久，最后还是选择了留下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài juédìng shìfǒu cízhí de wèntí shang yóuyù le hěnjiǔ, zuìhòu háishi xuǎnzé le liúxiàlái.
examples.english: He hesitated for a long time about whether to resign, and ultimately chose to stay.

examples.chinese: 这个新建的游泳池设备很齐全，吸引了很多附近的居民来办会员卡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīnjiàn de yóuyǒngchí shèbèi hěn q齐quán, xīyǐnle hěnduō fùjìn de jūmín lái bàn huìyuánkǎ.
examples.english: The newly built swimming pool has complete facilities and has attracted many nearby residents to purchase membership cards.

examples.chinese: 这种蘑菇有毒，千万不要吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng mógu yǒudú, qiānwàn búyào chī.
examples.english: This type of mushroom is poisonous, so don't eat it under any circumstances.

examples.chinese: 长时间看手机对眼睛有害。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān kàn shǒujī duì yǎnjing yǒuhài.
examples.english: Looking at your phone for a long time is harmful to your eyes.

examples.chinese: 这次旅行让我们的友谊变得更加深厚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒmen de yǒuyì biàn de gèngjiā shēnhòu.
examples.english: This trip made our friendship much deeper.

examples.chinese: 他的演讲非常有力，说服了很多人支持这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng fēicháng yǒulì, shuōfúle hěnduō rén zhīchí zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: His speech was very forceful and convinced many people to support this project.

examples.chinese: 定期运动有利于保持身体健康和心理健康。
examples.pinyin: Dìngqī yùndòng yǒulìyú bǎochí shēntǐ jiànkāng hé xīnlǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Regular exercise is beneficial to maintaining both physical and mental health.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅有着悠久的历史和独特的味道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting yǒuzhe yōujiǔ de lìshǐ hé dúté de wèidào.
examples.english: This restaurant has a long history and unique flavors.

examples.chinese: 每个周末我都会和朋友一起打羽毛球，这是我最喜欢的运动。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu huì hé péngyou yìqǐ dǎ yǔmáoqiú, zhè shì wǒ zuì xǐhuān de yùndòng.
examples.english: Every weekend I play badminton with friends, which is my favorite sport.

examples.chinese: 明天要出差，我今天晚上要预备好行李。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào chūchāi, wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào yùbèi hǎo xíngli.
examples.english: I have a business trip tomorrow, so I need to get my luggage ready tonight.

examples.chinese: 冬天来了，我需要买一件羽绒服来保暖。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān lái le, wǒ xūyào mǎi yī jiàn yǔróngfú lái bǎonuǎn.
examples.english: Winter is coming, and I need to buy a down-filled garment to keep warm.

examples.chinese: 昨天的雨水冲走了路上的落叶，整条街都被冲得很干净。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de yǔshuǐ chōngzǒu le lù shang de luòyè, zhěng tiáo jiē dōu bèi chōng de hěn gān净.
examples.english: Yesterday's rainwater washed away the fallen leaves on the road, and the entire street was cleaned thoroughly.

examples.chinese: 今年元旦我们全家一起去旅游，计划已经做好了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián Yuándàn wǒmen quánjiā yīqǐ qù lǚyóu, jìhuà yǐjīng zuò hǎo le.
examples.english: This New Year's Day, our whole family is going to travel together, and the plans are already made.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的完成时间比我们预期的要长得多。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de wánchéng shíjiān bǐ wǒmen yùqī de yào cháng de duō.
examples.english: The completion time of this project is much longer than we expected.

examples.chinese: 要想学好编程，首先要理解计算机的基本原理。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng xuéhǎo biānchéng, shǒuxiān yào lǐjiě jìsuànjī de jīběn yuánlǐ.
examples.english: If you want to learn programming well, you first need to understand the basic principles of computers.

examples.chinese: 这座城市的园林设计得很精美，吸引了很多游客来参观。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de yuánlín shèjì de hěn jīngměi, xīyǐnle hěnduō yóukè lái cānguān.
examples.english: The gardens in this city are designed beautifully, attracting many tourists to visit.

examples.chinese: 原先我们计划在春天去旅游，但是后来因为工作太忙就取消了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiān wǒmen jìhuà zài chūntiān qù lǚyóu, dànshì hòulái yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng jiù qǔxiāo le.
examples.english: Originally we planned to travel in spring, but later we canceled it because work was too busy.

examples.chinese: 这些原始的设计理念现在看起来已经过时了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē yuánshǐ de shèjì lǐ念 xiànzài kànqǐlai yǐjīng guòshí le.
examples.english: These original design concepts now look outdated.

examples.chinese: 他不怨别人，只怨自己没有好好珍惜那个机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā búyuàn biéren, zhǐ yuàn zìjǐ méiyǒu hǎohāo zhēnxī nàge jīhuì.
examples.english: He doesn't blame others; he only blames himself for not cherishing that opportunity.

examples.chinese: 这个公司保留了原有的管理团队，继续保持高效的运营。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī bǎoliúle yuányǒu de guǎnlǐ tuánduì, jìxù bǎochíle gāoxiào de yùnyíng.
examples.english: The company retained its originally possessed management team and continued to maintain efficient operations.

examples.chinese: 远处的山峰在夕阳下显得格外美丽。
examples.pinyin: Yuǎnchù de shānfēng zài xīyáng xià xiǎnde géwài měilì.
examples.english: The mountains in the distance looked particularly beautiful under the setting sun.

examples.chinese: 我愿意帮你搬家，但是你得自己准备搬家工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuànyì bāng nǐ bānjiā, dànshì nǐ děi zìjǐ zhǔnbèi bānjiā gōngjù.
examples.english: I'm willing to help you move, but you need to prepare the moving tools yourself.

examples.chinese: 父母不应该过度约束孩子的自由，这样会影响他们的成长。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ búyīnggāi guòdù yuēshù háizi de zìyóu, zhèyàng huì yǐngxiǎng tāmen de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: Parents shouldn't excessively control their children's freedom, as this will affect their development.

examples.chinese: 中秋节的时候，我们全家人坐在一起吃月饼，边吃边聊天。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiū jié de shíhou, wǒmen quánjiā rén zuò zài yìqǐ chī yuèbing, biān chī biān liáotiān.
examples.english: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, our whole family sits together eating moon cakes while chatting.

examples.chinese: 这个图书馆的阅览室很安静，我喜欢在那里读书。
examples.pinyin: Zhège túshūguǎn de yuèlǎnshì hěn ānjìng, wǒ xǐhuān zài nàli dúshū.
examples.english: The reading room in this library is very quiet, and I like to read books there.

english: to move along one's course (of celestial bodies etc)

examples.chinese: 这颗卫星已经在太空中运行了十多年，仍然工作得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē wèixīng yǐjīng zài tàikōng zhōng yùnxíng le shí duō nián,仍然 gōngzuò de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This satellite has been operating in space for over ten years and is still working well.

examples.chinese: 这家公司主要负责货物运输，每天都有很多卡车在路上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhǔyào fùzé huòwù yùnshū, měi tiān dōu yǒu hěnduō kǎchē zài lùshang.
examples.english: This company is mainly responsible for cargo transportation, with many trucks on the road every day.

examples.chinese: 科学家们正在研究如何在月球上建立人类基地。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé zài yuèqiú shang jiànlì rénlèi jīdì.
examples.english: Scientists are researching how to establish a human base on the moon.

examples.chinese: 这个地区经常遭受自然灾害，政府正在采取措施来保护居民的生命财产安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū jīngcháng zāoshòu zìránhuà zāihài, zhèngfǔ zhèngzài cǎiqǔ cuòshī lái bǎohù jūmín de shēngmìng cáichǎn ānquán.
examples.english: This region frequently suffers from natural disasters, and the government is taking measures to protect residents' lives and property.

examples.chinese: 这次洪水灾害造成了很多人失去了家园。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì hónghuǐ zāihài zàochéngle hěnduō rén shīqùle jiāyuán.
examples.english: This flood disaster caused many people to lose their homes.

examples.chinese: 经理在会议上再次强调了这个项目的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang zàicì qiángdiào le zhège xiàngmù de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: The manager emphasized the importance of this project once again at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 政府已经向灾区派遣了救援队，希望能尽快帮助那里的人们。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yǐjīng xiàng zāiqū pāiqiǎnle jiùyuán duì, xīwàng néng jìnkuài bāngzhù nàlǐ de rénmen.
examples.english: The government has already dispatched rescue teams to the disaster area, hoping to help the people there as quickly as possible.

examples.chinese: 这场地震是我们城市历史上最严重的灾难，许多人失去了他们的家园。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dìzhèn shì wǒmen chéngshì lìshǐ shang zuì yánzhòng de zāinàn, xǔduō rén shīqù le tāmen de jiāyuán.
examples.english: This earthquake was the most serious affliction in our city's history, and many people lost their homes.

examples.chinese: 昨天的会议很重要，公司所有的高管都在场了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de huìyì hěn zhòngyào, gōngsī suǒyǒu de gāoguǎn dōu zàichǎng le.
examples.english: Yesterday's meeting was very important, and all the company executives were present.

examples.chinese: 公司的所有员工，包括经理在内，都需要参加这次培训。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de suǒyǒu yuángōng, bāokuò jīnglǐ zàinèi, dōu xūyào cānjiā zhè cì péixùn.
examples.english: All employees of the company, including managers, need to attend this training.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅暂时关闭了，我们去别的地方吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zànshí guānbìle, wǒmen qù biéde dìfang chīfàn ba.
examples.english: This restaurant is temporarily closed, let's go eat somewhere else.

examples.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，比赛被暂停了两个小时。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, bǐsài bèi zàntíng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Due to severe weather, the match was suspended for two hours.

examples.chinese: 自从搬到了新城市，他再也没有回过故乡。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng bāndào le xīn chéngshì, tā zàiyě méiyǒu huíguò gùxiāng.
examples.english: Ever since moving to the new city, he hasn't returned to his hometown anymore.

examples.chinese: 那场战争把整个城市糟蹋得不成样子。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng zhànzh争 bǎ zhěngge chéngshì zāotàpode búchéng yàngzi.
examples.english: That war devastated the entire city beyond recognition.

examples.chinese: 今天的天气糟糕，所以我们决定取消野餐计划。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì zāogāo, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng qǔxiāo yěc餐 jìhuà.
examples.english: The weather today is terrible, so we decided to cancel our picnic plan.

examples.chinese: 在早期的互联网时代，人们还不知道这项技术会如何改变世界。
examples.pinyin: Zài zǎoqī de hùliánwǎng shídài, rénmen háishi búzhīdào zhè xiàng jìshù huì rúhé gǎibiàn shìjiè.
examples.english: In the early period of the internet era, people still didn't know how this technology would change the world.

examples.chinese: 最近公司的销售额增加了百分之三十。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngsī de xiāoshòu'é zēngjiāle bǎifēnzhī sānshí.
examples.english: The company's sales have increased by thirty percent recently.

examples.chinese: 农民们通过使用新技术成功地增产了20%。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín men tōngguò shǐyòng xīn jìshù chénggōng de zēngchǎn le 20%。
examples.english: The farmers successfully increased production by 20% through the use of new technology.

examples.chinese: 随着公司的发展，我们的办公室面积增大了很多。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gōngsī de fāzhǎn, wǒmen de bàngōngshì miànjī zēngdà le hěnduō.
examples.english: As the company developed, our office space enlarged considerably.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网的发展，越来越多的人选择在线购物，实体店的客流量反而减少了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de rén xuǎnzé zàixiàn gòuwù, shítǐdiàn de kèliúliàng fǎn'ér jiǎnshao le.
examples.english: With the development of the internet, more and more people choose to shop online, while the foot traffic in physical stores has actually decreased.

examples.chinese: 经常运动可以增强我们的体质和免疫力。
examples.pinyin: Jīngcháng yùndòng kěyǐ zēngqiáng wǒmen de tǐzhì hé miǎnyìlì.
examples.english: Regular exercise can strengthen our physical constitution and immunity.

examples.chinese: 他从树上摘了几个苹果放在篮子里。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng shù shang zhāi le jǐ ge píngguǒ fàng zai lánzi li.
examples.english: He picked a few apples from the tree and put them in a basket.

examples.chinese: 为了感谢你的帮助，我想赠送你一份礼物。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gǎnxiè nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒ xiǎng zèngsòng nǐ yī fèn lǐwù.
examples.english: To thank you for your help, I would like to give you a gift.

examples.chinese: 这个美术馆的展览吸引了很多游客来参观。
examples.pinyin: Zhège měishùguǎn de zhǎnlǎn xīyǐnle hěnduō yóukè lái cānguān.
examples.english: The exhibition at this art museum attracted many visitors to come and view it.

examples.chinese: 公司为了感谢员工的辛苦工作，决定在年底赠送每个人一份礼物。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèile gǎnxiè yuángōng de xinku gōngzuò, juéding zài niándǐ zèngsòng měi ge rén yī fèn lǐwù.
examples.english: To thank employees for their hard work, the company decided to present each person with a gift at the end of the year.

examples.chinese: 敌军占领了这座城市已经三个月了。
examples.pinyin: Díjūn zhànlǐngle zhè zuò chéngshì yǐjīng sān ge yuè le.
examples.english: The enemy troops have occupied this city for three months already.

examples.chinese: 这部电影通过精彩的表演展现了人物复杂的内心世界。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng tōngguò jīngcǎi de biǎoyǎn zhǎnxiàn le rénwù fùzá de nèixīn shìjiè.
examples.english: This film unfolds the characters' complex inner worlds through brilliant performances.

examples.chinese: 这个展览会展示了许多传统工艺品，让游客了解了中国的文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhǎnlǎnhuì zhǎnshìle xǔduō chuántǒng gōngyìpǐn, ràng yóukè liǎojiěle Zhōngguó de wénhuà.
examples.english: This exhibition revealed many traditional handicrafts, allowing visitors to understand Chinese culture.

examples.chinese: 这家公司占有了市场上百分之三十的份额。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhànyǒu le shìchǎng shang bǎi fēn zhī sānshí de fèn'é.
examples.english: This company owns thirty percent of the market share.

examples.chinese: 最近房价涨得太快了，很多年轻人买不起房子。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn fángjià zhǎng de tài kuài le, hěnduō niánqīng rén mǎi bu qǐ fángzi.
examples.english: Recently, house prices have risen too quickly, and many young people can't afford to buy houses.

examples.chinese: 由于原材料成本上升，很多工厂都计划在明年涨价。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào chéngběn shàngshēng, hěnduō gōngchǎng dōu jìhuà zài míngniánduàng zhǎng jià.
examples.english: Due to rising raw material costs, many factories are planning to raise prices next year.

examples.chinese: 要想在这个行业成功，你必须掌握最新的技术。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng zài zhège hángyè chénggōng, nǐ bìxū zhǎngwò zuìxīn de jìshù.
examples.english: If you want to succeed in this industry, you must master the latest technology.

examples.chinese: 这所大学今年招生的人数比去年增加了百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué jīnnián zhāoshēng de rénshù bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
examples.english: This university recruited twenty percent more students this year than last year.

examples.chinese: 在车站里，她看到远处的朋友，立刻向他招手。
examples.pinyin: Zài chēzhàn lǐ, tā kàndào yuǎnchù de péngyou, lìkè xiàng tā zhāo shǒu.
examples.english: At the train station, she spotted her friend in the distance and immediately waved to him.

examples.chinese: 这些老照片对我来说非常珍贵，因为它们记录了我童年最美好的回忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē lǎo zhàopiàn duì wǒ lái shuō fēicháng zhēnguì, yīnwèi tāmen jìlùle wǒ tóngnián zuì měihǎo de huíyì.
examples.english: These old photos are very valuable to me because they record the most wonderful memories of my childhood.

examples.chinese: 这条珍珠项链是我奶奶留给我的传家宝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo zhēnzhū xiàngliàn shì wǒ nǎinai liúgěi wǒ de chuánjiābǎo.
examples.english: This pearl necklace is a family heirloom that my grandmother left for me.

examples.chinese: 我们应该珍惜和家人一起的每一刻时光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhēnxī hé jiārén yīqǐ de měi yī kè shíguāng.
examples.english: We should treasure every moment we spend together with our family.

examples.chinese: 他用真诚的态度和我们谈论了这个问题，我们都感到很受感动。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhēnchéng de tàidù hé wǒmen tǎolùnle zhège wèntí, wǒmen dōu gǎndào hěn shòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: He discussed this issue with us in a sincere manner, and we were all deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 经过调查，警察终于发现了真相，原来凶手是他的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò diàochá, jǐngchá终于 fāxiànle zhēnxiàng, yuánlái凶shǒu shì tāde péngyou.
examples.english: After investigation, the police finally discovered the truth: the murderer turned out to be his friend.

examples.chinese: 医生通过各种检查诊断出我患有轻度贫血。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò gèzhǒng jiǎnchá zhěnduàn chū wǒ huànyǒu qīngdù pínxiě.
examples.english: The doctor diagnosed me with mild anemia through various tests.

examples.chinese: 科学家们花费了几十年才发现了这个真理。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen huāfèile jǐ shí nián cái fāxiànle zhège zhēnlǐ.
examples.english: It took scientists decades to discover this truth.

examples.chinese: 地震时，整栋楼都在剧烈振动，我们赶紧跑到了空地上。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí, zhěng dòng lóu dōu zài jùliè zhèndòng, wǒmen gǎnkuài pǎo dào le kōngdì shang.
examples.english: During the earthquake, the entire building was shaking violently, so we quickly ran to the open ground.

examples.chinese: 听到这个消息时，我感到非常震惊，完全没有想到会发生这样的事情。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī shí, wǒ gǎndào fēicháng zhènjīng, wánquán méiyǒu xiǎngdào huì fāshēng zhèyàng de shìqing.
examples.english: When I heard this news, I was very shocked and never expected something like this would happen.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的结局引起了很大的争议，有人喜欢，有人不满意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéjú yǐnqǐle hěn dà de zhēngyì, yǒurén xǐhuān, yǒurén búmǎnyì.
examples.english: The ending of this movie sparked considerable controversy, with some people liking it and others dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 这个软件很便宜，但我不确定是不是正版的，所以还是决定从官方网站上购买。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn hěn piányí, dàn wǒ búquèdìng shìbushì zhèngbǎn de, suǒyǐ háishi juédìng cóng guāngfāng wǎngzhàn shang gòumǎi.
examples.english: This software is very cheap, but I'm not sure if it's genuine, so I decided to buy it from the official website instead.

examples.chinese: 正如你所说的那样，这个项目需要更多的时间和资源才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngrú nǐ suǒ shuōde nàyàng, zhège xiàngmù xūyào gèngduō de shíjiān hé zīyuán cáinéng wánchéng.
examples.english: Just as you said, this project needs more time and resources to be completed.

examples.chinese: 这家医院是正规的医疗机构，医生都有执照。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn shì zhèngguī de yīliào jīgòu, yīshēng dōu yǒu zhízhào.
examples.english: This hospital is a regular medical institution, and all the doctors have licenses.

examples.chinese: 警察通过监控录像证实了他的说法。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá tōngguò jiānkòng lùyìng zhèngshíle tā de shuōfǎ.
examples.english: The police confirmed his statement through surveillance footage.

examples.chinese: 他考过了英语考试，获得了国际认可的证书。
examples.pinyin: Tā kǎoguòle yīngyǔ kǎoshì, huòdéle guójì rènkě de zhèngshū.
examples.english: He passed the English exam and obtained an internationally recognized credential.

examples.chinese: 法官必须维护正义，不能被金钱所影响。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān bìxū wéihù zhèngyì, búnéng bèi jīnqián suǒ yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Judges must uphold justice and cannot be influenced by money.

examples.chinese: 他每天都在忙着挣钱，几乎没有时间陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài máng zhe zhèng qián, jī hū méi yǒu shí jiān péi jiā rén.
examples.english: He is busy making money every day and hardly has time to spend with his family.

examples.chinese: 这个项目必须在三个月之内完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù bìxū zài sān ge yuè zhīnèi wánchéng.
examples.english: This project must be completed within three months.

examples.chinese: 他在水里挣扎了几分钟才游上岸。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shuǐ lǐ zhēngzhá le jǐ fēnzhōng cái yóu shàng àn.
examples.english: He struggled in the water for a few minutes before swimming back to shore.

examples.chinese: 除了工作之外，他最喜欢的事情就是看书和旅游。
examples.pinyin: Chúle gōngzuò zhīwài, tā zuì xǐhuān de shìqing jiùshi kànshū hé lǚyóu.
examples.english: Besides work, his favorite things are reading and traveling.

examples.chinese: 在众多的选择之中，她最终决定去北京发展自己的事业。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhòngduō de xuǎnzé zhīzhōng, tā zuìzh終 juédìng qù Běijīng fāzhǎn zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Among the many choices, she finally decided to go to Beijing to develop her career.

examples.chinese: 在这种压力之下，他决定放弃这个工作机会。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng yālì zhīxià, tā juédìng fàngqì zhège gōngzuò jīhuì.
examples.english: Under this kind of pressure, he decided to give up this job opportunity.

examples.chinese: 公司决定明天执行新的工作计划。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng míngtiān zhíxíng xīn de gōngzuò jìhuà.
examples.english: The company decided to carry out the new work plan tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 公司今年的支出比去年增加了百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián de zhīchū bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
examples.english: The company's expenditure this year has increased by twenty percent compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 从这里到公司最快的路线是直线距离，但实际上我们要绕过那座山。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào gōngsī zuì kuài de lùxiàn shì zhíxiàn jùl离, dàn shíjì shang wǒmen yào raòguò nà zuò shān.
examples.english: The quickest route from here to the company is the straight-line distance, but in reality we have to go around that mountain.

examples.chinese: 经理支配了整个项目的时间表，确保一切按计划进行。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhīpèile zhěngge xiàngmù de shíjiānbiǎo, quèbǎo yīqiè ànjihuà jìnxíng.
examples.english: The manager arranged the project's schedule to ensure everything proceeded as planned.

examples.chinese: 今晚轮到我值班，所以我不能去参加朋友的聚会。
examples.pinyin: Jīnwǎn lúndào wǒ zhíbān, suǒyǐ wǒ búnéng qù cānjiā péngyou de jùhuì.
examples.english: It's my turn to work the shift tonight, so I can't go to my friend's gathering.

examples.chinese: 他最近升职到了经理的职位，工作变得更加忙碌了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn shēngzhí dàole jīnglǐ de zhíwèi, gōngzuò biàn de gèngjiā mánglu le.
examples.english: He was recently promoted to the position of manager, and his work has become much busier.

examples.chinese: 政府部门的职能是为人民服务，保护他们的权益。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bùmén de zhínéng shì wèi rénmín fúwù, bǎohù tāmen de quányì.
examples.english: The function of government departments is to serve the people and protect their rights.

examples.chinese: 他之所以没来，只不过是因为他今天有点不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhīsuǒyǐ méi lái, zhǐbuguò shì yīnwèi tā jīntiān yǒudiǎn búshūfu.
examples.english: The reason he didn't come is only because he wasn't feeling well today.

examples.chinese: 我推开门，只见客厅里坐满了人，大家都在等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tuīkāi mén, zhǐjiàn kètīng lǐ zuòmǎn le rén, dàjiā dōu zài děng wǒ.
examples.english: I pushed open the door and only saw that the living room was full of people, everyone was waiting for me.

examples.chinese: 公司今年的销售指标是增长百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián de xiāoshòu zhǐbiāo shì zēngzhǎng bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
examples.english: The company's sales directive for this year is to achieve twenty percent growth.

examples.chinese: 他因为工作能力强，最近被提升到了一个重要的职务。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò néngglì qiáng, zuìjìn bèi tíshēng dàole yīgè zhònyào de zhíwù.
examples.english: Because of his strong work ability, he was recently promoted to an important position.

examples.chinese: 经理给我们指示了新项目的具体要求。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ gěi wǒmen zhǐshìle xīn xiàngmù de jùtǐ yāoqiú.
examples.english: The manager indicated to us the specific requirements of the new project.

examples.chinese: 我的指甲长得太快了，每周都要剪一次。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhǐjia zhǎng de tài kuài le, měi zhōu dōu yào jiǎn yī cì.
examples.english: My fingernails grow so fast that I have to trim them every week.

examples.chinese: 媒体指责政府没有采取足够的措施来解决这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Méitǐ zhǐzé zhèngfǔ méiyǒu cǎiqǔ z足够 de cuòshī lái jiějué zhège wèntí.
examples.english: The media censured the government for not taking sufficient measures to solve this problem.

examples.chinese: 这座雕像是用大理石制成的，花了工匠三年的时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò diāoxiàng shì yòng dàlǐshí zhìchéng de, huāle gōngjiàng sān nián de shíjiān.
examples.english: This statue was hewn from marble and took the craftsman three years to complete.

examples.chinese: 从早上至晚上，他一直在忙着准备考试。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zǎoshang zhì wǎnshang, tā yīzhí zài mángzhe zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
examples.english: From morning to evening, he has been busy preparing for the exam.

examples.chinese: 这个城市的治安很好，晚上出门也很安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de zhìān hěn hǎo, wǎnshang chūmén yě hěn ānquán.
examples.english: This city has good public safety; it's also very safe to go out at night.

examples.chinese: 经济发展往往受到资源和环境的制约。
examples.pinyin: jīngjì fāzhǎn wǎngwǎng shòudào zīyuán hé huanjìng de zhìyuē.
examples.english: Economic development is often restricted by resources and the environment.

examples.chinese: 由于技术故障，会议被迫中断了两个小时。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú jìshù gùzhàng, huìyì bèi pòpò zhōngduàn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Due to a technical malfunction, the meeting was forced to be cut short for two hours.

english: the Mid-Autumn Festival on 15th of 8th lunar month

examples.chinese: 今年中秋节我们全家一起在阳台上赏月，吃了很多月饼。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián zhōngqiūjié wǒmen quánjiā yìqǐ zài yángtái shang shǎnyuè, chīle hěnduō yuèbing.
examples.english: This year during the Mid-Autumn Festival, our whole family gathered on the balcony to admire the moon and ate lots of mooncakes.

examples.chinese: 政府需要加强对环境污染的治理，保护我们的家园。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào jiāqiáng duì huanjìng wūrǎn de zhìlǐ, bǎohù wǒmen de jiāyuán.
examples.english: The government needs to strengthen the management of environmental pollution to protect our homeland.

examples.chinese: 中央政府最近宣布了一项新的改革政策。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyāng zhèngfǔ zuìjìn xuānbùle yī xiàng xīn de gǎigé zhèngcè.
examples.english: The central authorities recently announced a new reform policy.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶相信中药比西药更安全，所以她总是坚持喝中药调理身体。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai xiāngxìn zhōngyào bǐ xīyào gèng ānquán, suǒyǐ tā zǒngshì jiānchí hējiǔ zhōngyào tiáolǐ shēntǐ.
examples.english: My grandmother believes that traditional Chinese medicine is safer than Western medicine, so she always insists on drinking herbal medicine to regulate her health.

examples.chinese: 这条路的终点是一个美丽的湖泊，每年都有很多游客来这里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù de zhōngdiǎn shì yī ge měilì de húpō, měi nián dōu yǒu hěnduō yóukè lái zhèlǐ.
examples.english: The terminal point of this road is a beautiful lake, and many tourists come here every year.

examples.chinese: 他决定终身致力于教育事业，希望能帮助更多的学生。
examples.pinyin: Tā jué定 zhōngshēn zhìlì yú jiàoyù shìyè, xīwàng néng bāngzhù gèngduō de xuésheng.
examples.english: He decided to dedicate his lifetime to education, hoping to help more students.

examples.chinese: 由于销售业绩不理想，公司决定终止与这家供应商的合作。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xiāoshòu yèjī bù lǐxiǎng, gōngsī jué定 zhōngzhǐ yǔ zhè jiā gōngyìngshāng de hézuò.
examples.english: Due to unsatisfactory sales performance, the company decided to terminate its cooperation with this supplier.

examples.chinese: 那家餐厅的食物不卫生，有很多顾客都因为吃了他们的饭菜而中毒了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cānting de shíwù bù wèishēng, yǒu hěnduō gùkè dōu yīnwèi chīle tāmen de fàncài érhuà zhòngdú le.
examples.english: The food at that restaurant is unhygienic, and many customers got food poisoning from eating their meals.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的开发周期大约需要六个月。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de kāifā zhōuqī dàyuē xūyào liù ge yuè.
examples.english: The development cycle for this project will take approximately six months.

examples.chinese: 这个城市有众多的美食餐厅，每天都吸引很多游客来品尝。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒu zhòngduō de měishí cāntīng, měi tiān dōu xīyǐn hěnduō yóukè lái pǐncháng.
examples.english: This city has multitudinous food restaurants that attract many tourists every day to taste the cuisine.

examples.chinese: 这个公园里种了很多竹子，走在竹林里感觉特别凉爽。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán lǐ zhòngle hěnduō zhúzi, zǒu zài zhúlín lǐ gǎnjué tèbié liánghuǎng.
examples.english: There are many bamboo plants in this park, and walking through the bamboo forest feels particularly cool and refreshing.

examples.chinese: 这次国际电影节由我们城市主办，预计会吸引很多著名导演参加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì diànyǐng jié yóu wǒmen chéngshì zhǔbàn, yùjì huì xīyǐn hěnduō zhùmíng dǎoyǎn cānjiā.
examples.english: This international film festival is sponsored by our city, and it is expected to attract many renowned directors to participate.

examples.chinese: 你不应该用主观的看法来判断别人，要更加客观一些。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyīnggāi yòng zhǔguān de kànfǎ lái pànduàn biérén, yào gèngjiā kèguān yīxiē.
examples.english: You shouldn't judge others based on subjective opinions; you need to be more objective.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的主体已经完成，现在只需要做一些细节的修改。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de zhǔtǐ yǐjīng wánchéng, xiànzài zhǐ xūyào zuò yīxiē xì節de xiūgǎi.
examples.english: The main body of this project has been completed; now we only need to make some detailed revisions.

examples.chinese: 我需要先征求主管的意见，才能做出这个决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào xiān zh征qiú zhǔguǎn de yìjiàn, cáinéng zuòchū zhège juéding.
examples.english: I need to get my supervisor's opinion first before I can make this decision.

examples.chinese: 我的助理帮我整理了所有的会议文件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhùlǐ bāng助我zhěnglǐle suǒyǒu de huìyì wénjiàn.
examples.english: My aide helped me organize all the meeting documents.

examples.chinese: 这位研究助手在实验室里工作了三年，积累了很多宝贵的经验。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yánjiū zhùshǒu zài shíyàn shì lǐ gōngzuò le sān nián, jīlěi le hěnduō báoguì de jīngyàn.
examples.english: This research assistant has been working in the laboratory for three years and has accumulated a lot of valuable experience.

examples.chinese: 这个项目由我们公司主导，预计明年完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yóu wǒmen gōngsī zhǔdǎo, yùjì míngnián wánchéng.
examples.english: Our company is leading this project, which is expected to be completed next year.

examples.chinese: 他注视着窗外的雨景，思考着人生的意义。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhùshìzhe chuāngwài de yǔjǐng, sīkǎozhe rénshēng de yìyì.
examples.english: He watched attentively at the rain outside the window, contemplating the meaning of life.

examples.chinese: 医生给病人注射了疫苗来预防流感。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén zhùshèle yìmiáo lái yùfáng liúgǎn.
examples.english: The doctor injected the patient with a vaccine to prevent the flu.

examples.chinese: 我需要注册一个新的电子邮箱账户来接收公司的邮件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào zhùcè yīgè xīn de diànzǐ yóujiàn zhànghu lái jiēshōu gōngsī de yóujiàn.
examples.english: I need to register a new email account to receive emails from the company.

examples.chinese: 现在很多公司都注重员工的培训和发展。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěnduō gōngsī dōu zhùzhòng yuángōng de péixùn hé fāzhǎn.
examples.english: Nowadays, many companies lay stress on training and development of their employees.

examples.chinese: 我们都为他的成功祝贺，因为他花了很多年才实现这个梦想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu wèi tā de chénggōng zhùhè, yīnwèi tā huāle hěnduō nián cái shíxiàn zhège梦想。
examples.english: We all congratulated him on his success because it took him many years to realize this dream.

examples.chinese: 这位歌手最新的专辑在网上获得了很多好评。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gēshǒu zuì xīn de zhuānjí zài wǎngshang huòdéle hěnduō hǎopíng.
examples.english: This singer's latest album has received many positive reviews online.

examples.chinese: 这家公司花了三年时间才获得了这项技术的专利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī huāle sān nián shíjiān cái huòdéle zhè xiàng jìshù de zhuānlì.
examples.english: It took this company three years to obtain the patent for this technology.

examples.chinese: 这个公司成功地把传统业务转化为数字化服务，获得了很多新客户。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī chénggōng de bǎ chuántǒng yèwù zhuǎnhuà wéi shùzìhuà fúwù, huòdéle hěnduō xīn kèhù.
examples.english: The company successfully transformed its traditional business into digital services and gained many new customers.

examples.chinese: 我们需要转换一下思路，才能找到解决这个问题的办法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhuǎnhuàn yīxià sīlù, cáinéng zhǎodào jiějué zhège wèntí de bànfǎ.
examples.english: We need to change our way of thinking in order to find a solution to this problem.

examples.chinese: 这家公司决定把专利技术转让给另一个国家的企业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī juédìng bǎ zhuānlì jìshù zhuǎnràng gěi lìng yī ge guójiā de qǐyè.
examples.english: This company decided to transfer its patent technology to a company in another country.

examples.chinese: 公司决定转向新的市场，放弃了原来的业务。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng zhuǎnxiàng xīn de shìchǎng, fàngqì le yuánlái de yèwù.
examples.english: The company decided to change direction toward a new market and abandoned its original business.

examples.chinese: 这个新房间需要一些绿色植物来装饰，这样看起来会更舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn fángjiān xūyào yīxiē lǜsè zhíwù lái zhuāngshì, zhèyàng kànqǐlai huì gèng shūfu.
examples.english: This new room needs some green plants to decorate it, so it will look more comfortable.

examples.chinese: 他骑自行车的时候不小心撞到了一辆停在路边的汽车。
examples.pinyin: Tā qī zìxíngchē de shíhou búxiǎoxin zhuàngdào le yī liàng tíng zài lùbiān de qìchē.
examples.english: While riding his bicycle, he accidentally knocked into a car parked on the side of the road.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的主要资产是它的技术和人才团队。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔyào zīchǎn shì tā de jìshù hé réncái tuánduì.
examples.english: This company's main resources are its technology and talented team.

examples.chinese: 创办一个成功的公司需要足够的资本和良好的商业计划。
examples.pinyin: Chuàngbàn yīgè chénggōng de gōngsī xūyào zúggòu de zīběn hé liánghǎo de shāngyè jìhuà.
examples.english: Starting a successful company requires sufficient capital and a good business plan.

examples.chinese: 警察找到了枪和几颗子弹，这是破案的关键证据。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhǎodào le qiāng hé jǐ kē zǐdàn, zhè shì pòàn de guānjiàn zhèngjù.
examples.english: The police found the gun and several bullets, which are key evidence for solving the case.

examples.chinese: 你需要仔细阅读这份合同，确保没有遗漏任何重要条款。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào zǐxì yuèdú zhè fèn hétongjù, quèbǎo méiyǒu yíluò rènhé zhòngyào tiáokuǎn.
examples.english: You need to read this contract carefully to make sure you don't miss any important clauses.

examples.chinese: 政府资助了这个科研项目，希望能推动新技术的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zīzhù le zhège kēyán xiàngmù, xīwàng néng tuīdòng xīn jìshù de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The government subsidized this research project, hoping to promote the development of new technology.

examples.chinese: 心理医生说抑郁症患者有自杀的风险，所以家人要多加关注。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ yīshēng shuō yìyùzhèng huànzhě yǒu zìshā de fēngxiǎn, suǒyǐ jiārén yào duō jiāzhù guānzhù.
examples.english: The psychiatrist said that patients with depression have the risk of committing suicide, so family members need to pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 她穿着一件紫色的连衣裙，看起来特别优雅。
examples.pinyin: Tā穿着一件zǐsè de liányīqún, kàn qǐlai tèbié yōuyǎ.
examples.english: She wore a purple dress that looked particularly elegant.

examples.chinese: 作为中国人，我们为自己悠久的文化历史感到自豪。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi Zhōngguórén, wǒmen wèi zìjǐ yōujiǔ de wénhuà lìshǐ gǎndào zìháo.
examples.english: As Chinese people, we feel proud of our long cultural history.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的总裁宣布了一项新的发展战略。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de zǒngcái xuānbù le yī xiàng xīn de fāzhǎn zhàny略。
examples.english: The CEO of this company announced a new development strategy.

examples.chinese: 今年参加比赛的总数比去年增加了20%。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián参加 bǐsài de zǒngshù bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle 20%。
examples.english: The total number of participants in this year's competition increased by 20% compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 总体来说，这个项目的进展还是不错的，虽然遇到了一些困难。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǐ lái shuō, zhège xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn háishi búcuò de, suīrán遇dàole yīxiē kùnnan.
examples.english: Overall, the progress of this project is quite good, although we've encountered some difficulties.

examples.chinese: 等了三个小时，公交车总算来了。
examples.pinyin: Děngle sān ge xiǎoshí, gōngjiāochē zǒngsuàn lái le.
examples.english: After waiting for three hours, the bus finally arrived.

examples.chinese: 很多年轻人自愿去偏远地区教书，因为他们想为社会做出贡献。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō niánqīngrén zìyuàn qù piānyuǎn dìqū jiāoshū, yīnwèi tāmen xiǎng wèi shèhuì zuòchū gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Many young people voluntarily go to remote areas to teach because they want to make contributions to society.

examples.chinese: 这些老旧的规定阻碍了公司的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē lǎojiù de guīdìng zǔài le gōngsī de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: These outdated regulations hinder the company's development.

examples.chinese: 医生通过显微镜观察病人的组织样本。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò xiǎnwēijìng guānchá bìngrén de zǔzhī yàngběn.
examples.english: The doctor observed the patient's tissue sample under a microscope.

examples.chinese: 他喝了太多酒，醉得连路都走不了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hēle tàiduō jiǔ, zuì de lián lù dōu zǒu buliǎo.
examples.english: He drank too much alcohol and got so intoxicated that he couldn't even walk straight.

examples.chinese: 我们都很尊敬这位老教授，因为他在学术上做出了巨大的贡献。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu hěn zūnjìng zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu, yīnwèi tā zài xuéshù shang zuòchūle jùdà de gòngxiàn.
examples.english: We all respect this elderly professor very much because he has made great contributions to academia.

examples.chinese: 在团队合作中，我们应该尊重每个人的意见和想法。
examples.pinyin: Zài tuánduì hézuò zhōng, wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng měi ge rén de yìjiàn hé xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: In team collaboration, we should respect everyone's opinions and ideas.

examples.chinese: 作为员工，我们必须遵守公司的规章制度。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yuángōng, wǒmen bìxū zūnshǒu gōngsī de guīzhāng zhìdù.
examples.english: As employees, we must abide by the company's rules and regulations.
